Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event.
Comments (English): [ It really washes amazingly well! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. Reason for Purchase: Single-person households, couples, or families of two to three often don't need a full-sized dishwasher. Especially in small spaces like studio apartments, a compact, easy-to-install mini dishwasher is perfect. Many people looking to reduce daily dishwashing time and maintain hygiene are likely to choose this product when looking for a compact dishwasher for three people. I also purchased this product because I wanted to reduce dishwashing time and spend more time with my wife. Pros: Compact design: Mini size that can be stored in a small kitchen even in tight spaces. Capacity for three people: Ideal for one to three-person households, it's the perfect size for washing a day's worth of dishes at once. Clean charcoal gray color: Blends well with any interior and exudes a luxurious feel. Versatile cleaning modes: Practical features like a powerful wash, water-saving mode, and drying function are included. Self-installation: Simple connection without a technician visit, reducing initial costs. Energy and Water Savings: Reduces water usage compared to hand washing, and detergent efficiency is also high, making it economical. Disadvantages: Customer Installation Burden: Initial installation can be cumbersome for those without installation experience. I live in a rental, so I plan to use the water supply from the main unit. Large Container Limitations: Large cooking utensils like pots and pans require separate hand washing due to limited washing space. Noise: While quieter than larger models, it's not completely silent, which can be a concern in small studio apartments. Price Concerns: Despite its compact size, the initial cost is considerably higher than that of a regular dishwasher. Detergent Selection Required: Because it requires a dedicated dishwasher detergent, maintenance costs are added. Sentence (English): I'm writing a review of the MyDear Automatic Door Open UV Lamp Dishwasher, 6-Person, White, MDWMT0601W-WINE-KR.
Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher is better than you think, no-hagong construction! ] || ---------------- || I'm writing a review of the MyDear Automatic Door Open UV Lamp Dishwasher, 6-Person, White, MDWMT0601W-WINE-KR. To sum it up, this is a highly satisfactory product for households with small kitchens, households of two or three, or those looking to reduce dishwashing time. While the capacity is listed as 6-person, it was actually more than enough to wash a family of four or five for a day. It was spacious enough to accommodate bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, chopsticks, spoons, and even small pots. The efficient interior design allowed me to wash more dishes than I expected with proper storage. It's also compact, making it the perfect fit next to my apartment kitchen sink. I was also very satisfied with the installation. The installer visited my home to perform the installation, but I was hesitant to drill a hole in my sink, so I requested a no-drill installation. The dedicated attachment connects to the faucet, eliminating the need for drilling holes in the sink and leaving no trace, making it convenient for moving later. The drain was also neatly organized, allowing me to use it immediately after installation. The cleaning power and hygiene features exceeded my expectations. The high-temperature wash thoroughly removed grease and food residue, and the door automatically opened after the wash, allowing moisture inside to escape and drying naturally. The UV lamp also activated for a sterilizing effect, virtually eliminating musty odors and water dripping. I especially appreciated the peace of mind I felt when washing baby dishes and bottles. The washing cycles were varied, with options like standard, quick, and strong, allowing me to choose the right one for my needs. Even at night, the noise level was quiet, which didn't bother me. The automatic door opening function was a real plus in my experience. After the wash was complete, the door opened slightly to release hot steam, leaving the inside dry and crisp. The lack of a separate, lengthy drying cycle also helped save energy. The white design blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. The intuitive controls made it easy for even first-time users to get used to it. The reduction in water usage was also noticeable, significantly reducing the amount of water used compared to hand washing. Long-term savings on electricity and water bills are also expected. One drawback is that, because it's designed for six people, it's difficult to store large cooking utensils like large pots and pans. This may be inconvenient depending on the size of your frequently used utensils. However, if you primarily use basic tableware at home, it's sufficiently satisfactory. Overall, the Mydia Auto-Open UV Lamp Dishwasher for 6 People is a reasonably priced product with a no-punch installation option and excellent cleaning, sterilization, and drying capabilities. We highly recommend it for dual-income families or families with children who want to reduce dishwashing time.

With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Sentence (English): A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won!
Comments (English): [ Assetmom's Escape from Dishwashing Hell! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Sentence (English): No pre-washing, yes cleanliness.
Comments (English): [ Assetmom's Escape from Dishwashing Hell! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Comments (English): [ Assetmom's Escape from Dishwashing Hell! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Samsung's 6-Person Dishwasher: You're My Destiny ] || ---------------- || With three kids, even just one meal leaves a mountain of dishes! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! With plates, spoons, chopsticks, and water glasses, it's literally a dishwashing nightmare. I used to use a Cuckoo 3-person dishwasher, but it broke, so I started hand-washing for a while. It was a real tearjerker. (The repair cost was similar to the cost of a new one.) A large 12-person one was too much, so I was looking for a 6-person one, and thanks to a credit card discount, I got it for around 400,000 won! Cleaning power? No pre-washing, yes cleanliness. I'm lazy, so I don't actually do pre-washing. I just rinse it with water and put it back in? But this guy really did it, and I was amazed at how thoroughly he cleaned it. Even soup stains and rice stains disappeared! Just add detergent tablets, and it takes care of everything for you. It's like a smart housekeeper. Automatic door opening = a whole new world experience. When you're done, the door automatically opens with a whoosh, evaporating moisture and drying! Wow, this is a whole new world feature that only those who have actually used it know. It's a bit stressful when the dishes aren't fully dry after washing them, but this one doesn't have that worry at all. The higher-end models even have hot air drying, but I'm not sure. The reason it's more convenient is because with a large 12-person model, you have to wait for all the dishes to be filled, so it feels like you're rushing through the dishes, but with a 6-person model, you can get them done right after eating. This is actually much more practical for me! I can just quickly wash things like large pots by hand. The design is also a passing grade. The beige color makes it subtly classy in the kitchen. It's simple and not flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior design. It feels like the perfect 'neat kitchen item'. My husband also complimented me, saying, "The kitchen looks prettier now that I put this in it." Oh, and why is this so quiet? The dishwasher I used before was doing the dishes~~~~~ I'm drying them now~~~~~ I went around telling everyone in the neighborhood, but the Samsung dishwasher is so quiet that I keep looking at it to see if it's working. Summary of advantages: Good cleaning power (no need for larvae) Automatic door opening Drying function is a new world 6-person size, so it's good for washing dishes right away after each meal Clean design, doesn't spoil the interior Disappointing points: Honestly, I still have to hand wash large pots and frying pans (but my frying pan is a big one, 30cm. Anyway, it seems like it would fit in a 12-person size.) The amount that can be put in at once is limited compared to a 12-person size There is a rinse aid dispenser, but I use tablet detergent, so it's useless Conclusion = Definitely a must-have item for life There may be people who have never used a dishwasher, but no one has used one only once. Yes, that's me. Now that I'm freed from washing dishes by hand, my quality of life has really improved. I can play with the kids or have a cup of coffee while it's running. For me, it's the best parenting and household item! Overall Review: Perfect for moms, with a realistic size, powerful cleaning power, and a beautiful design. Highly recommended! Sentence (English): The design isn't overly flashy, and it goes well with our cream-colored sink.
Comments (English): [ It seems like a dishwasher that costs just that much. ] || ---------------- || The design isn't overly flashy, and it goes well with our cream-colored sink. I like that I don't have to worry about filter maintenance like with the Samsung. The installer was very friendly. I told the sink company the size and model and made a plan, but the installer said it didn't fit, so I thought he wouldn't be able to install it, but he handled it well. We're a family of four, and the kids are still babies, so they don't have a lot of dishes, so we usually cook two or three meals at a time. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, it's really big, so we have to do three meals at a time to fill it up. Pots and cooking bowls fit! After installation, they told me how to lower the basket and other things, but I don't remember them. I'm using it because it's convenient, and I'll look into it later. It has hot air drying, steam, and sterilization functions, making it convenient for managing children's dishes in the summer. (I don't use it every time due to electricity bills.) I even spin the baby bottles in the dishwasher. The machine doesn't have a separate rinse function, but you can download it to your phone. There are a lot of downloadable programs available. It would be nice if there was a soaking function, but that's a bit disappointing. The steam function is a bit cumbersome. And you have to do this a few times to clean it thoroughly. There's a cleaning program for stuck-on food in the LG ThinQ app, but I don't bother using it. I used a stand-alone washer before, so the extra cleaning isn't that inconvenient. Oh, and the touch buttons don't work well when my hands get wet. But this one, like the stand-alone washer, has a strange food smell inside. My previous stand-alone washer had that same smell, so I thought it was just because it was a stand-alone, but this one has the same smell. There was no food stuck in the mesh, so I'm going to give it a full wash tomorrow to see what the problem is. I had high expectations when I bought this washer, but it wasn't as good as I expected.

It is actually slowly removing some stains I thought had become permanent and the haze on my glassware is disappearing. I really appreciate how tailor-able the machine settings are, especially with regards to water hardness and rinse agent dosage. The rollers also come off the track rather easily. Overall, the robustness of the racks and sliders as well as the versatility and usefulness of the adjustable tines is not nearly as nice as the GE Profile dishwasher I had previously.

The control panel is bad and a service call/parts/labor would cost more than what we originally paid for the dishwasher. And according to the ThinQ diagnostics, nothing is wrong! We should have invested in a higher quality brand and we wouldn't have wasted our money. This is apparently a known issue with this company, but they continue to sell products that will not last. Also, the bottom rack often comes off its track while sliding in/out.

Sentence (English): I had to replace my almost 15 year old Kenmore dishwasher and first purchased a GE.
Comments (English): [ Happy I Purchased a Bosch! ] || ---------------- || I had to replace my almost 15 year old Kenmore dishwasher and first purchased a GE. After the first use, I hated it - returned it - and for a few hundred dollars more, got the Bosch. Best thing I ever did! It is beyond the quietest unit ever, cleans everything shiny/spotless! I love the app ability and the different setting choices. I do have a few negatives but mainly design things. First, the teeny-weeny utensil basket is ridiculous! I threw it out and purchased an OEM one double the size and am now happy. Second, the way the lower rack is designed, I can not get as much in there as with my older unit which is a major bummer. Last, that 3rd rack is basically useless to me. I used it the first time for lids which I found when I pulled it out after use, all the items only retained water even though the Crystal Dry had been used. Still, the positives outweigh the negatives (for now any way). I highly recommend spending the $$$ to get a topnotch appliance!

Please read the owner's manual because it's super helpful, especially for people that have never owned a Bosch dishwasher. So many complaints would be solved by reading the users manual :) Especially the part about emptying and cleaning the filter. Please note, we do have a water softener and an iron out machine on our well water which adds to the life of all your appliances. Get Bosched! You will not regret it.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I'm very satisfied with the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person. First of all, the biggest advantage of this product is its no-installation design. It was incredibly convenient to be able to use it right out of the box, without any plumbing or complicated installation. This is a huge advantage for those who have been hesitant about installing a dishwasher. Especially for those like me who live in an older apartment with a small kitchen, fitting a regular dishwasher can be challenging. This product's compact size allowed me to place it comfortably in even the smallest of spaces. I'm very satisfied with its space efficiency. It also uses surprisingly little water. Initially, I thought it would use a lot of water because it's so small, but it actually uses significantly less than washing dishes by hand. It's economical and environmentally friendly because it only requires a certain amount of water to clean. Most importantly, its cleaning power is surprisingly thorough. I rarely had to laboriously rinse greasy dishes or pots by hand beforehand, and I'm always amazed at how sparkling clean they are after washing. It's incredibly convenient because it can accommodate basic tableware like cups, rice bowls, soup bowls, and spoons, as well as small cooking utensils. While the capacity isn't large for three people, it's enough for one or two uses a day for a one- to three-person household. The biggest satisfaction I've had is that dishes don't pile up in the sink, keeping the kitchen much cleaner and reducing the stress of washing dishes. The simple and sophisticated design blends well with any kitchen interior, and its simple operation makes it easy for anyone to use. It's so compact yet practical and powerful that I wonder why I bought it sooner. At first, I was skeptical about how much use it would have because of its small size, but now it's become a daily kitchen essential. I highly recommend it to single people, newlyweds, small families with children, and anyone with limited kitchen space.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  미닉스 미니 식기세척기 PRO 3인용 정말 만족하면서 사용 중입니다.  우선 이 제품의 가장 큰 장점은 무설치 방식이라는 점이에요. 별도의 배관 연결이나 복잡한 설치 과정 없이 박스를 열자마자 바로 사용할 수 있어서 정말 편리했습니다. 설치 문제 때문에 식기세척기를 고민하던 분들께는 큰 장점일 것 같습니다. 특히 저처럼 구형 아파트에 살면서 주방 구조가 협소한 경우, 일반 식기세척기를 들여놓기가 쉽지 않은데, 이 제품은 크기가 컴팩트해서 작은 공간에도 부담 없이 놓을 수 있었습니다. 공간 활용 면에서 만족도가 굉장히 높아요.  물 사용량도 의외로 적습니다. 처음에는 작은 제품이라 물을 많이 써야 할 줄 알았는데, 오히려 손 설거지를 할 때보다 물을 훨씬 적게 쓰는 것 같아요. 일정량의 물만으로도 세척이 가능하니 경제적이고, 환경적인 부분에서도 장점이 있죠.  무엇보다 중요한 건 세척력인데, 생각 이상으로 깔끔하게 세척이 됩니다. 기름기 많은 접시나 냄비도 미리 힘들게 손으로 헹굴 필요가 거의 없었고, 세척 후 꺼내보면 반짝반짝 깨끗해져 있어서 매번 감탄합니다. 컵, 밥그릇, 국그릇, 수저 같은 기본 식기는 물론 작은 조리도구도 함께 넣어 돌릴 수 있어서 아주 편리합니다.  용량은 3인용이라 크지 않지만, 1~3인 가구라면 하루 한두 번 돌리는 걸로 충분합니다. 실제로 사용해보니 싱크대에 그릇이 쌓이지 않아서 주방이 훨씬 깔끔하게 유지되고, 설거지 스트레스가 줄어든 게 가장 큰 만족 포인트입니다.  디자인도 심플하고 세련돼서 주방 인테리어와 잘 어울리고, 조작도 간단해서 누구나 쉽게 사용할 수 있습니다. 작은 크기에 실용성과 성능을 다 잡은 제품이라 “왜 이제서야 샀을까” 하는 생각이 들 정도예요.  처음에는 “작아서 얼마나 쓸까?” 하고 반신반의했는데, 지금은 매일 사용하는 주방 필수템이 되었습니다. 혼자 사는 분들, 신혼부부, 아이 있는 작은 가정, 그리고 주방 공간이 좁은 분들께 강력 추천드리고 싶습니다.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ It's neat and nice ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I got a home appliance that I've always wanted to try. It's so great, I told my husband about it, and he said it opened up a whole new world of dishwashing. He was also envious. First of all, the Minix Mini Dishwasher Pro 3-Person arrived quickly. However, when I tried to open it, the box was delivered upside down. There was a sponge stuck inside the box, so there was no defect in the product, but I wasn't very happy about it. I thought it would be small because it's mini, but it was a bit bulky when I received it. It's not easy for a woman to lift alone, but it's a size and weight that I can carry. The color is charcoal gray, and I really liked it because it matches the water purifier in my house. However, the dust was easily visible, so I thought I'd have to cover it with something. My kitchen is mostly dark, so this was perfect. Installation wasn't that difficult. Just put the water tank up, attach the accessories to the end, and place the main unit on top of it. After that, you just need to properly connect the drain hose to the back of the main unit and you're done. If you pull the hose out to the side toward the dishwasher, the water will drain there whenever you use it. I think the biggest advantage is that it can be installed without drilling. One of the disadvantages is that you have to find a place to put it, such as a sink, but I think it can be done. And the instruction booklet is very detailed and explains where and what to put the dishes. It looks nice. The interior has a two-tiered tray structure. You can put plates, bowls, cups, etc. on the bottom, and spoons and cooking utensils on the top. It doesn't hold as many dishes as you might think because it's small. But I think this is okay for me. If you arrange it well, it will be okay. I recommend it for a one- or two-person household. I think it can be used by up to three people without any problems. I have a tornado rotating blade on the top and bottom of the interior. Here. The water stream is quite powerful, and you can fill it by pulling the water tank inlet at the bottom. Another disadvantage is that it has to be filled every time it is used, perhaps because it is a mini. However, it is designed to hold up to 7-8 liters, so it seems to run once or twice without any problems. When there is no water, the product itself makes a "beep" sound. When you fill it with water, the product displays "full" and you can stop. After larvae are removed and the dishes with fishy smells are put in and the dishwasher is running, all the smells are gone and it comes out dry, which is great. The advantage is that there are no installation space restrictions and no need to connect a drain pipe. However, the manual method of adding water is a bit inconvenient. The detergent is added. At first, I was told to put it in the area with writing on the bottom, but after searching for a while, I found a stainless steel area around the water source. I just placed it there. It was easy. The Minix dishwasher has six modes to choose from: Economy, Standard, Powerful, Quick, Internal Wash, and Dry. Yes, I often use the standard mode. And it's a small, multi-functional dishwasher that not only washes, but also sterilizes and dries. When you're concerned about residual moisture or unpleasant odors from stacking dishes, you can use the drying function, which dries the dishes thoroughly for 1 hour and 20 minutes. It even sterilizes and deodorizes them. I'm satisfied because I can manage my kitchen utensils hygienically by using the drying function without having to sterilize them separately. At first, I was worried that it might be noisy if I ran it at night, but the Minix is **designed for low noise**, so it's much quieter than I thought. But it would be noisy at night, right? Of course, I wouldn't run it too late at night. There's the sound of running water and a slight fan during the wash, but it's enough to ignore while watching TV or listening to music. Dishwashers are often expensive, but the Minix is "reasonably priced," so even single-person households, young adults, and those living alone can afford it without too much of a burden. It has many reviews saying that it offers good value for money compared to similar compact dishwashers, and it comes with a dedicated detergent, so you don't have to worry about additional costs.
