Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Sentence (English): It's time to welcome my aunt.
Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Sentence (English): ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once!
Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, made with my own money ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to write a review~ I wanted to use it enough and write a proper review after using it~ -------------------------------------------------- 6/12 Purchase + Peace of Mind Care 5-year free warranty 6/13 Installation 7/21 Water leak, received at AS center 7/24 AS technician visited, new product exchange confirmed 7/31 Exchange completed -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to put away the dishes and saw that the bottom of the sink was soaked with water~ I thought it was strange, so I turned on the dishwasher and saw that water was dripping through the gap in the back, so I applied for AS that morning~ The fastest visit took 3 days~ Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician disassembled the entire body and checked the symptoms. He said that it was a case he had never seen before and that it would be difficult to replace parts. He said that if a problem occurs within a month of installation, it is possible to exchange it, but unfortunately, since it was already a month later, he said that he would contact the headquarters and see if an exchange was possible,,, and fortunately, the exchange decision was made, so I exchanged it for a new product and am still using it well~ (I wasn't lucky with the draw, but I got an exchange, so Thank goodness) I went back to the dishwashing hell for 10 days and ate out a lot -------------------------------------------------------------- I've been married for 8 years, but since both of us work, we didn't cook much at home, so we lived without a dishwasher. After the baby was born, I had to prepare the baby's food regularly, so the amount of dishes increased, and I thought I really needed to buy one. I thought that if I continued like this, my relationship with my husband would become more distant, so I held out and bought it~ I was worried until the day of payment. I had doubts like, "Is this really your aunt?" and I thought that it would need a lot of water since it runs for over an hour, so I think I delayed the purchase a bit more because of my worries about the management fee. I bought it for around 400,000 won with a card discount and also registered for the peace of mind care. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!) and two technicians came, and unlike other reviews, they were very friendly. It was possible to extend the pipe through the gap without drilling holes like a water purifier, but I drilled holes because they said that the water pressure might drop and I might need to reinstall it. Drilling took less than 30 seconds. There is no manual, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I chose standard, rapid, and powerful? I've only been using that function, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the ProgMini that everyone uses, and I used the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It took a while because I'm not good at Tetris, but now it's very fast after doing it every day. I hate the smell caused by food scraps and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in. (I just skim out the food, leaving the grease in.) Maybe that's why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there's no smell at all. Except for large pots, it can easily hold enough dishes for a meal for a family of three, and the operating noise is almost the same as the noise from everyday life. (It doesn't bother me at all when I have the TV on in the living room or playing with the baby.) A few minutes before the dishwasher is finished, the lid opens, letting the hot steam escape. If it's left that way, even after a day, moisture remains, so to increase the natural drying effect, I open the door wide before going to bed, take the drying rack outside, and put the dishes away the next morning. (I use smooth dishes or The cups are all dry, but there is still moisture in the grooves and curved parts like the lid of the lunch box, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish~) Using the dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar. But as I quickly got used to it, I thought, "This is why they call it 'auntie, aunt'" and while I resented myself for buying it late, I praised myself for making a good purchase ^^ I'll summarize what I've felt for nearly three months~ Pros: The stress of washing dishes has disappeared (I used to multi-task while washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden, and I just run the dishwasher at the end and that's it!) My legs don't hurt because the dishwashing time has been shortened, and the baby waits for me less and plays with the baby more (I'm so happy). My husband and I don't fight anymore, and he doesn't hate me, and his stress has also decreased. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. I don't know if it's a problem with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, but white water stains (residual detergent?) can be seen in small crevices (the same thing happens even if I split the detergent or add an extra rinse. ) So there is the hassle of double washing (I often rinse baby dishes with hot water again out of concern) After the operation is over and you leave it as is, the water does not dry at all Overall: I didn't feel much of a change in the management cost (electricity bill, water bill) that I was worried about before and after the dishwasher was installed~ (I didn't check the exact unit ^^;) It would be more convenient if there was hot air drying, but it's not that difficult for me to open the door and take out the drying rack before going to bed~ The kitchen space has gotten smaller, but it's actually easier to organize and the kitchen has become neater~ The hassle of rinsing the white part (I suspect detergent residue) that is visible in the gap between the baby's plates is bearable~ It could be a detergent problem, so I'm going to try changing it once in the middle~ I think I know why people around me recommend a dishwasher~ I'm 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take long for others. It's time to welcome my aunt. ^^ Since purchasing the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought over the dishes once! It's brought peace to our family, and it's no exaggeration to say it's the smartest purchase I made this year! Above all, it's a truly precious product that has given me precious evening time with my baby. This is my honest review after using it for three months, so I hope it's helpful to those of you who are currently considering it. ^^

그 기능만 돌려쓰고 있어서 아직 크게 어려운점은 없네요~  식세기 도착 전 다들 쓰신다는 프로그미니를 준비해 놓고 설치당일 저녁에 식세기를 처음 돌려 보았어요~ 테트리스가 서툴러 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 매일 하다보니 이제는 속도가 굉장히 빠르답니다~~ 저는 음식찌꺼기로 인해 발생되는 냄새와 잦은 거름망 청소가 싫어서 찬물로 애벌설거지를 한번 하고 넣어요~ (음식물만 걷어내는 정도, 기름기는 그대로 둠) 그래서인지 아직 거름망청소 알람이 울린적은 없어요 냄새도 전혀 안나고요~ 커다란 냄비류 빼고는 요리포함 3인식구 한끼식사 식기류를 거뜬히 들어가고 작동 소리는 생활소음과 거의 맞먹어요~ (거실에 티비를 틀어놓거나 아기랑 놀때 전혀 신경쓰이지 않아요) 식세기 끝나기 몇분 전 뚜껑이 열리면서 뜨거운 김이 빠지고 그 상태로는 하루가 지나도 물기가 그대로 남아 있기 때문에 자연건조 효과를 높이기 위해 자기 전 문을 활짝 열어서 건조대를 바깥으로 빼주고 다음날 아침에 식기를 정리합니다~ (매끈한 그릇이나 컵은 다 말라있지만 그래도 반찬통 뚜껑같은 홈이나 굴곡진 부분에는 물기가 남아있어 키친타올로 닦아서 마무리해요~)  첫 식세기 사용이 다소 낯설었지만... 금방 적응이 되면서 \'이래서 이모님이모님 하는구나 ㅠㅠ\' 라는 생각에 늦게 구매한 저를 원망하면서도 이제라도 잘샀다 하고 스스로를 칭찬했어요 ^^ 세달가까이 느낀점을 정리해보겠습니다~  장점 : 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌다 (요리할때 설거지하면서 멀티로 했는데 이제는 요리만 하면서 식기를 많이 사용해도 부담 없고 마지막에 식세기 돌려주면 끝!!) 설거지 시간이 단축되면서 다리가 안아프다, 아기가 엄마를 기다려주는 시간이 줄었고 아기랑 놀아주는 시간이 늘어났다 (너무 행복해요 ㅠㅠ)  남편이랑 안싸운다, 남편이 안밉다, 남편도 스트레스가 줄었다고 한다....!!!!  단점 : 주방이 좁아졌다 ㅠㅠ 세제의 문제인지 식세기 세정력에 문제인지 작은 틈 사이에 하얀물때 (잔류세제? ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ) 작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다  총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;)  열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~ 주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~  아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~ 왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~  저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^  식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!! 무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^
