Sentence (English): I understand now why people recommend dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Bought with my own money, Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to leave a review. I wanted to use it thoroughly and leave a proper review based on actual usage. -------------------------------------------------- June 12: Purchased + 5-year 安心Care warranty. June 13: Installed. July 21: Leak occurred, reported to AS center. July 24: Service technician visited, replacement confirmed. July 31: Replacement completed. -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to organize the dishes and noticed the bottom of the sink was soaked with water. Thinking something was wrong, I turned on the dishwasher and confirmed that water was dripping from the gap at the back, so I requested AS that same morning. The earliest visit took 3 days. Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician had to completely disassemble the unit to check the symptoms. He said it was a case he had never seen before and that replacing parts would likely be difficult. He mentioned that exchanges are possible if the problem occurs within one month of installation, but unfortunately, since a month had passed, he would contact the head office to see if an exchange was possible. Fortunately, it was approved for exchange, so I received a new product and have been using it well ever since. (I didn't have much luck with the lottery, but I'm glad it was exchanged.) For the past ten days, I was back to the hell of washing dishes by hand, so I ate out quite often. --------------------------------------------------------------. We have been married for 8 years, and since we are a dual-income couple, we rarely ate at home, so we managed without a dishwasher. However, after our baby was born and I had to prepare meals for the baby regularly, the amount of dishwashing increased significantly. I thought, "I really need to buy one now. If I keep putting it off, my relationship with my husband will grow even more," so after holding out for as long as I could, I finally made the purchase. Even up until the day of payment, I was still hesitant. I had doubts: "Is it really a professional dishwasher?" and "If it runs for over an hour, doesn't it need much more water?" I think I delayed the purchase a bit longer because I was worried about maintenance costs. Thanks to a card discount, I bought it for around 400,000-450,000 won and also registered for the Safety Care service. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!), and two technicians came; unlike other reviews, they were very kind. Although it was possible to run the pipe through the gap without drilling, like with a water purifier, I opted to have a hole drilled because they mentioned that a reinstallation might be necessary if the water pressure dropped. The drilling took less than 30 seconds. There was no manual included, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I only use the Standard, Rapid, and Powerful functions, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the Frog Mini that everyone uses, and I tried running the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It used to take a while because I wasn't very good at Tetris, but after doing it every day, I’ve become incredibly fast now. I dislike the smell caused by food residue and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in (just enough to remove food scraps, leaving the grease on). Perhaps that is why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there is absolutely no smell. Except for large pots and pans, it easily fits all the tableware for a meal for a family of three, including cooking, and the operating noise is comparable to everyday noise (it doesn't bother me at all when the TV is on in the living room or when I'm playing with my baby). Since the lid opens and hot steam escapes a few minutes before the dishwasher finishes, and moisture remains in that state for a day, I open the door wide and pull the drying rack outside before bed to maximize the natural drying effect, and then organize the dishes the next morning. (Smooth dishes and cups are completely dry, but moisture still remains in grooves or curved parts like food container lids, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish.) Using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar, but I adapted quickly. Thinking, "This is why people call it a 'Do-Auntie'," I resented buying it so late, but at the same time, I congratulated myself for making the right purchase. I will summarize my thoughts after nearly three months. Pros: Dishwashing stress has disappeared (I used to multitask by washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden; I just run the dishwasher at the end and I'm done!). My legs don't hurt as dishwashing time has shortened. The time my baby waits for me has decreased, and the time I spend playing with the baby has increased (I am so happy). I don't fight with my husband, I don't hate him, and he says his stress has decreased as well. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. Whether it is an issue with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, I see white water stains (residual detergent?) in the small crevices (it is the same even if I break the detergent packet or add an extra rinse). Therefore, there is the hassle of double-washing (I am worried about the baby's dishes, so I often scrub them one more time with hot water before rinsing). If left as is after the cycle ends, the water does not dry at all. Overall review: I didn't notice any significant change in the maintenance costs (electricity, water) before and after getting the dishwasher, which I was worried about. (I didn't calculate it meticulously down to the unit of currency ^^;) It would be more convenient if it had a hot air dryer, but opening the door and taking out the drying rack before bed isn't a big hassle for me. Although the usable kitchen space has shrunk, organizing has actually become easier, making the kitchen look much neater. The extra hassle of rinsing the white spots visible in the crevices of the baby's food tray (suspected to be residual detergent) is bearable. It might be a detergent issue, so I plan to try switching it out sometime. I understand now why people recommend dishwashers. I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher. Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes. It has brought peace to our family, and it is no exaggeration to say it is the smartest purchase of the year! Above all, it is a truly grateful product that gifted me precious time to spend with my baby in the evenings. This is an honest review based on my experience using it for 3 months, so I hope it helps those who are currently considering buying one.

Sentence (English): I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Bought with my own money, Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to leave a review. I wanted to use it thoroughly and leave a proper review based on actual usage. -------------------------------------------------- June 12: Purchased + 5-year 安心Care warranty. June 13: Installed. July 21: Leak occurred, reported to AS center. July 24: Service technician visited, replacement confirmed. July 31: Replacement completed. -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to organize the dishes and noticed the bottom of the sink was soaked with water. Thinking something was wrong, I turned on the dishwasher and confirmed that water was dripping from the gap at the back, so I requested AS that same morning. The earliest visit took 3 days. Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician had to completely disassemble the unit to check the symptoms. He said it was a case he had never seen before and that replacing parts would likely be difficult. He mentioned that exchanges are possible if the problem occurs within one month of installation, but unfortunately, since a month had passed, he would contact the head office to see if an exchange was possible. Fortunately, it was approved for exchange, so I received a new product and have been using it well ever since. (I didn't have much luck with the lottery, but I'm glad it was exchanged.) For the past ten days, I was back to the hell of washing dishes by hand, so I ate out quite often. --------------------------------------------------------------. We have been married for 8 years, and since we are a dual-income couple, we rarely ate at home, so we managed without a dishwasher. However, after our baby was born and I had to prepare meals for the baby regularly, the amount of dishwashing increased significantly. I thought, "I really need to buy one now. If I keep putting it off, my relationship with my husband will grow even more," so after holding out for as long as I could, I finally made the purchase. Even up until the day of payment, I was still hesitant. I had doubts: "Is it really a professional dishwasher?" and "If it runs for over an hour, doesn't it need much more water?" I think I delayed the purchase a bit longer because I was worried about maintenance costs. Thanks to a card discount, I bought it for around 400,000-450,000 won and also registered for the Safety Care service. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!), and two technicians came; unlike other reviews, they were very kind. Although it was possible to run the pipe through the gap without drilling, like with a water purifier, I opted to have a hole drilled because they mentioned that a reinstallation might be necessary if the water pressure dropped. The drilling took less than 30 seconds. There was no manual included, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I only use the Standard, Rapid, and Powerful functions, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the Frog Mini that everyone uses, and I tried running the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It used to take a while because I wasn't very good at Tetris, but after doing it every day, I’ve become incredibly fast now. I dislike the smell caused by food residue and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in (just enough to remove food scraps, leaving the grease on). Perhaps that is why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there is absolutely no smell. Except for large pots and pans, it easily fits all the tableware for a meal for a family of three, including cooking, and the operating noise is comparable to everyday noise (it doesn't bother me at all when the TV is on in the living room or when I'm playing with my baby). Since the lid opens and hot steam escapes a few minutes before the dishwasher finishes, and moisture remains in that state for a day, I open the door wide and pull the drying rack outside before bed to maximize the natural drying effect, and then organize the dishes the next morning. (Smooth dishes and cups are completely dry, but moisture still remains in grooves or curved parts like food container lids, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish.) Using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar, but I adapted quickly. Thinking, "This is why people call it a 'Do-Auntie'," I resented buying it so late, but at the same time, I congratulated myself for making the right purchase. I will summarize my thoughts after nearly three months. Pros: Dishwashing stress has disappeared (I used to multitask by washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden; I just run the dishwasher at the end and I'm done!). My legs don't hurt as dishwashing time has shortened. The time my baby waits for me has decreased, and the time I spend playing with the baby has increased (I am so happy). I don't fight with my husband, I don't hate him, and he says his stress has decreased as well. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. Whether it is an issue with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, I see white water stains (residual detergent?) in the small crevices (it is the same even if I break the detergent packet or add an extra rinse). Therefore, there is the hassle of double-washing (I am worried about the baby's dishes, so I often scrub them one more time with hot water before rinsing). If left as is after the cycle ends, the water does not dry at all. Overall review: I didn't notice any significant change in the maintenance costs (electricity, water) before and after getting the dishwasher, which I was worried about. (I didn't calculate it meticulously down to the unit of currency ^^;) It would be more convenient if it had a hot air dryer, but opening the door and taking out the drying rack before bed isn't a big hassle for me. Although the usable kitchen space has shrunk, organizing has actually become easier, making the kitchen look much neater. The extra hassle of rinsing the white spots visible in the crevices of the baby's food tray (suspected to be residual detergent) is bearable. It might be a detergent issue, so I plan to try switching it out sometime. I understand now why people recommend dishwashers. I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher. Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes. It has brought peace to our family, and it is no exaggeration to say it is the smartest purchase of the year! Above all, it is a truly grateful product that gifted me precious time to spend with my baby in the evenings. This is an honest review based on my experience using it for 3 months, so I hope it helps those who are currently considering buying one.

Sentence (English): Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Bought with my own money, Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to leave a review. I wanted to use it thoroughly and leave a proper review based on actual usage. -------------------------------------------------- June 12: Purchased + 5-year 安心Care warranty. June 13: Installed. July 21: Leak occurred, reported to AS center. July 24: Service technician visited, replacement confirmed. July 31: Replacement completed. -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to organize the dishes and noticed the bottom of the sink was soaked with water. Thinking something was wrong, I turned on the dishwasher and confirmed that water was dripping from the gap at the back, so I requested AS that same morning. The earliest visit took 3 days. Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician had to completely disassemble the unit to check the symptoms. He said it was a case he had never seen before and that replacing parts would likely be difficult. He mentioned that exchanges are possible if the problem occurs within one month of installation, but unfortunately, since a month had passed, he would contact the head office to see if an exchange was possible. Fortunately, it was approved for exchange, so I received a new product and have been using it well ever since. (I didn't have much luck with the lottery, but I'm glad it was exchanged.) For the past ten days, I was back to the hell of washing dishes by hand, so I ate out quite often. --------------------------------------------------------------. We have been married for 8 years, and since we are a dual-income couple, we rarely ate at home, so we managed without a dishwasher. However, after our baby was born and I had to prepare meals for the baby regularly, the amount of dishwashing increased significantly. I thought, "I really need to buy one now. If I keep putting it off, my relationship with my husband will grow even more," so after holding out for as long as I could, I finally made the purchase. Even up until the day of payment, I was still hesitant. I had doubts: "Is it really a professional dishwasher?" and "If it runs for over an hour, doesn't it need much more water?" I think I delayed the purchase a bit longer because I was worried about maintenance costs. Thanks to a card discount, I bought it for around 400,000-450,000 won and also registered for the Safety Care service. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!), and two technicians came; unlike other reviews, they were very kind. Although it was possible to run the pipe through the gap without drilling, like with a water purifier, I opted to have a hole drilled because they mentioned that a reinstallation might be necessary if the water pressure dropped. The drilling took less than 30 seconds. There was no manual included, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I only use the Standard, Rapid, and Powerful functions, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the Frog Mini that everyone uses, and I tried running the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It used to take a while because I wasn't very good at Tetris, but after doing it every day, I’ve become incredibly fast now. I dislike the smell caused by food residue and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in (just enough to remove food scraps, leaving the grease on). Perhaps that is why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there is absolutely no smell. Except for large pots and pans, it easily fits all the tableware for a meal for a family of three, including cooking, and the operating noise is comparable to everyday noise (it doesn't bother me at all when the TV is on in the living room or when I'm playing with my baby). Since the lid opens and hot steam escapes a few minutes before the dishwasher finishes, and moisture remains in that state for a day, I open the door wide and pull the drying rack outside before bed to maximize the natural drying effect, and then organize the dishes the next morning. (Smooth dishes and cups are completely dry, but moisture still remains in grooves or curved parts like food container lids, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish.) Using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar, but I adapted quickly. Thinking, "This is why people call it a 'Do-Auntie'," I resented buying it so late, but at the same time, I congratulated myself for making the right purchase. I will summarize my thoughts after nearly three months. Pros: Dishwashing stress has disappeared (I used to multitask by washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden; I just run the dishwasher at the end and I'm done!). My legs don't hurt as dishwashing time has shortened. The time my baby waits for me has decreased, and the time I spend playing with the baby has increased (I am so happy). I don't fight with my husband, I don't hate him, and he says his stress has decreased as well. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. Whether it is an issue with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, I see white water stains (residual detergent?) in the small crevices (it is the same even if I break the detergent packet or add an extra rinse). Therefore, there is the hassle of double-washing (I am worried about the baby's dishes, so I often scrub them one more time with hot water before rinsing). If left as is after the cycle ends, the water does not dry at all. Overall review: I didn't notice any significant change in the maintenance costs (electricity, water) before and after getting the dishwasher, which I was worried about. (I didn't calculate it meticulously down to the unit of currency ^^;) It would be more convenient if it had a hot air dryer, but opening the door and taking out the drying rack before bed isn't a big hassle for me. Although the usable kitchen space has shrunk, organizing has actually become easier, making the kitchen look much neater. The extra hassle of rinsing the white spots visible in the crevices of the baby's food tray (suspected to be residual detergent) is bearable. It might be a detergent issue, so I plan to try switching it out sometime. I understand now why people recommend dishwashers. I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher. Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes. It has brought peace to our family, and it is no exaggeration to say it is the smartest purchase of the year! Above all, it is a truly grateful product that gifted me precious time to spend with my baby in the evenings. This is an honest review based on my experience using it for 3 months, so I hope it helps those who are currently considering buying one.

Comments (English): [ Bought with my own money, Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to leave a review. I wanted to use it thoroughly and leave a proper review based on actual usage. -------------------------------------------------- June 12: Purchased + 5-year 安心Care warranty. June 13: Installed. July 21: Leak occurred, reported to AS center. July 24: Service technician visited, replacement confirmed. July 31: Replacement completed. -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to organize the dishes and noticed the bottom of the sink was soaked with water. Thinking something was wrong, I turned on the dishwasher and confirmed that water was dripping from the gap at the back, so I requested AS that same morning. The earliest visit took 3 days. Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician had to completely disassemble the unit to check the symptoms. He said it was a case he had never seen before and that replacing parts would likely be difficult. He mentioned that exchanges are possible if the problem occurs within one month of installation, but unfortunately, since a month had passed, he would contact the head office to see if an exchange was possible. Fortunately, it was approved for exchange, so I received a new product and have been using it well ever since. (I didn't have much luck with the lottery, but I'm glad it was exchanged.) For the past ten days, I was back to the hell of washing dishes by hand, so I ate out quite often. --------------------------------------------------------------. We have been married for 8 years, and since we are a dual-income couple, we rarely ate at home, so we managed without a dishwasher. However, after our baby was born and I had to prepare meals for the baby regularly, the amount of dishwashing increased significantly. I thought, "I really need to buy one now. If I keep putting it off, my relationship with my husband will grow even more," so after holding out for as long as I could, I finally made the purchase. Even up until the day of payment, I was still hesitant. I had doubts: "Is it really a professional dishwasher?" and "If it runs for over an hour, doesn't it need much more water?" I think I delayed the purchase a bit longer because I was worried about maintenance costs. Thanks to a card discount, I bought it for around 400,000-450,000 won and also registered for the Safety Care service. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!), and two technicians came; unlike other reviews, they were very kind. Although it was possible to run the pipe through the gap without drilling, like with a water purifier, I opted to have a hole drilled because they mentioned that a reinstallation might be necessary if the water pressure dropped. The drilling took less than 30 seconds. There was no manual included, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I only use the Standard, Rapid, and Powerful functions, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the Frog Mini that everyone uses, and I tried running the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It used to take a while because I wasn't very good at Tetris, but after doing it every day, I’ve become incredibly fast now. I dislike the smell caused by food residue and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in (just enough to remove food scraps, leaving the grease on). Perhaps that is why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there is absolutely no smell. Except for large pots and pans, it easily fits all the tableware for a meal for a family of three, including cooking, and the operating noise is comparable to everyday noise (it doesn't bother me at all when the TV is on in the living room or when I'm playing with my baby). Since the lid opens and hot steam escapes a few minutes before the dishwasher finishes, and moisture remains in that state for a day, I open the door wide and pull the drying rack outside before bed to maximize the natural drying effect, and then organize the dishes the next morning. (Smooth dishes and cups are completely dry, but moisture still remains in grooves or curved parts like food container lids, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish.) Using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar, but I adapted quickly. Thinking, "This is why people call it a 'Do-Auntie'," I resented buying it so late, but at the same time, I congratulated myself for making the right purchase. I will summarize my thoughts after nearly three months. Pros: Dishwashing stress has disappeared (I used to multitask by washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden; I just run the dishwasher at the end and I'm done!). My legs don't hurt as dishwashing time has shortened. The time my baby waits for me has decreased, and the time I spend playing with the baby has increased (I am so happy). I don't fight with my husband, I don't hate him, and he says his stress has decreased as well. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. Whether it is an issue with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, I see white water stains (residual detergent?) in the small crevices (it is the same even if I break the detergent packet or add an extra rinse). Therefore, there is the hassle of double-washing (I am worried about the baby's dishes, so I often scrub them one more time with hot water before rinsing). If left as is after the cycle ends, the water does not dry at all. Overall review: I didn't notice any significant change in the maintenance costs (electricity, water) before and after getting the dishwasher, which I was worried about. (I didn't calculate it meticulously down to the unit of currency ^^;) It would be more convenient if it had a hot air dryer, but opening the door and taking out the drying rack before bed isn't a big hassle for me. Although the usable kitchen space has shrunk, organizing has actually become easier, making the kitchen look much neater. The extra hassle of rinsing the white spots visible in the crevices of the baby's food tray (suspected to be residual detergent) is bearable. It might be a detergent issue, so I plan to try switching it out sometime. I understand now why people recommend dishwashers. I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher. Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes. It has brought peace to our family, and it is no exaggeration to say it is the smartest purchase of the year! Above all, it is a truly grateful product that gifted me precious time to spend with my baby in the evenings. This is an honest review based on my experience using it for 3 months, so I hope it helps those who are currently considering buying one.

Comments (English): [ Bought with my own money, Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to leave a review. I wanted to use it thoroughly and leave a proper review based on actual usage. -------------------------------------------------- June 12: Purchased + 5-year 安心Care warranty. June 13: Installed. July 21: Leak occurred, reported to AS center. July 24: Service technician visited, replacement confirmed. July 31: Replacement completed. -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to organize the dishes and noticed the bottom of the sink was soaked with water. Thinking something was wrong, I turned on the dishwasher and confirmed that water was dripping from the gap at the back, so I requested AS that same morning. The earliest visit took 3 days. Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician had to completely disassemble the unit to check the symptoms. He said it was a case he had never seen before and that replacing parts would likely be difficult. He mentioned that exchanges are possible if the problem occurs within one month of installation, but unfortunately, since a month had passed, he would contact the head office to see if an exchange was possible. Fortunately, it was approved for exchange, so I received a new product and have been using it well ever since. (I didn't have much luck with the lottery, but I'm glad it was exchanged.) For the past ten days, I was back to the hell of washing dishes by hand, so I ate out quite often. --------------------------------------------------------------. We have been married for 8 years, and since we are a dual-income couple, we rarely ate at home, so we managed without a dishwasher. However, after our baby was born and I had to prepare meals for the baby regularly, the amount of dishwashing increased significantly. I thought, "I really need to buy one now. If I keep putting it off, my relationship with my husband will grow even more," so after holding out for as long as I could, I finally made the purchase. Even up until the day of payment, I was still hesitant. I had doubts: "Is it really a professional dishwasher?" and "If it runs for over an hour, doesn't it need much more water?" I think I delayed the purchase a bit longer because I was worried about maintenance costs. Thanks to a card discount, I bought it for around 400,000-450,000 won and also registered for the Safety Care service. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!), and two technicians came; unlike other reviews, they were very kind. Although it was possible to run the pipe through the gap without drilling, like with a water purifier, I opted to have a hole drilled because they mentioned that a reinstallation might be necessary if the water pressure dropped. The drilling took less than 30 seconds. There was no manual included, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I only use the Standard, Rapid, and Powerful functions, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the Frog Mini that everyone uses, and I tried running the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It used to take a while because I wasn't very good at Tetris, but after doing it every day, I’ve become incredibly fast now. I dislike the smell caused by food residue and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in (just enough to remove food scraps, leaving the grease on). Perhaps that is why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there is absolutely no smell. Except for large pots and pans, it easily fits all the tableware for a meal for a family of three, including cooking, and the operating noise is comparable to everyday noise (it doesn't bother me at all when the TV is on in the living room or when I'm playing with my baby). Since the lid opens and hot steam escapes a few minutes before the dishwasher finishes, and moisture remains in that state for a day, I open the door wide and pull the drying rack outside before bed to maximize the natural drying effect, and then organize the dishes the next morning. (Smooth dishes and cups are completely dry, but moisture still remains in grooves or curved parts like food container lids, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish.) Using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar, but I adapted quickly. Thinking, "This is why people call it a 'Do-Auntie'," I resented buying it so late, but at the same time, I congratulated myself for making the right purchase. I will summarize my thoughts after nearly three months. Pros: Dishwashing stress has disappeared (I used to multitask by washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden; I just run the dishwasher at the end and I'm done!). My legs don't hurt as dishwashing time has shortened. The time my baby waits for me has decreased, and the time I spend playing with the baby has increased (I am so happy). I don't fight with my husband, I don't hate him, and he says his stress has decreased as well. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. Whether it is an issue with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, I see white water stains (residual detergent?) in the small crevices (it is the same even if I break the detergent packet or add an extra rinse). Therefore, there is the hassle of double-washing (I am worried about the baby's dishes, so I often scrub them one more time with hot water before rinsing). If left as is after the cycle ends, the water does not dry at all. Overall review: I didn't notice any significant change in the maintenance costs (electricity, water) before and after getting the dishwasher, which I was worried about. (I didn't calculate it meticulously down to the unit of currency ^^;) It would be more convenient if it had a hot air dryer, but opening the door and taking out the drying rack before bed isn't a big hassle for me. Although the usable kitchen space has shrunk, organizing has actually become easier, making the kitchen look much neater. The extra hassle of rinsing the white spots visible in the crevices of the baby's food tray (suspected to be residual detergent) is bearable. It might be a detergent issue, so I plan to try switching it out sometime. I understand now why people recommend dishwashers. I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher. Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes. It has brought peace to our family, and it is no exaggeration to say it is the smartest purchase of the year! Above all, it is a truly grateful product that gifted me precious time to spend with my baby in the evenings. This is an honest review based on my experience using it for 3 months, so I hope it helps those who are currently considering buying one.

Comments (English): [ Bought with my own money, Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The day has finally come to leave a review. I wanted to use it thoroughly and leave a proper review based on actual usage. -------------------------------------------------- June 12: Purchased + 5-year 安心Care warranty. June 13: Installed. July 21: Leak occurred, reported to AS center. July 24: Service technician visited, replacement confirmed. July 31: Replacement completed. -------------------------------------------------- On Monday morning, I went to organize the dishes and noticed the bottom of the sink was soaked with water. Thinking something was wrong, I turned on the dishwasher and confirmed that water was dripping from the gap at the back, so I requested AS that same morning. The earliest visit took 3 days. Since there was no error code on the product itself, the technician had to completely disassemble the unit to check the symptoms. He said it was a case he had never seen before and that replacing parts would likely be difficult. He mentioned that exchanges are possible if the problem occurs within one month of installation, but unfortunately, since a month had passed, he would contact the head office to see if an exchange was possible. Fortunately, it was approved for exchange, so I received a new product and have been using it well ever since. (I didn't have much luck with the lottery, but I'm glad it was exchanged.) For the past ten days, I was back to the hell of washing dishes by hand, so I ate out quite often. --------------------------------------------------------------. We have been married for 8 years, and since we are a dual-income couple, we rarely ate at home, so we managed without a dishwasher. However, after our baby was born and I had to prepare meals for the baby regularly, the amount of dishwashing increased significantly. I thought, "I really need to buy one now. If I keep putting it off, my relationship with my husband will grow even more," so after holding out for as long as I could, I finally made the purchase. Even up until the day of payment, I was still hesitant. I had doubts: "Is it really a professional dishwasher?" and "If it runs for over an hour, doesn't it need much more water?" I think I delayed the purchase a bit longer because I was worried about maintenance costs. Thanks to a card discount, I bought it for around 400,000-450,000 won and also registered for the Safety Care service. Installation was done the next day (as expected from Coupang!), and two technicians came; unlike other reviews, they were very kind. Although it was possible to run the pipe through the gap without drilling, like with a water purifier, I opted to have a hole drilled because they mentioned that a reinstallation might be necessary if the water pressure dropped. The drilling took less than 30 seconds. There was no manual included, but they explained how to use it simply and easily after installation. I only use the Standard, Rapid, and Powerful functions, so I haven't had any major difficulties yet. Before the dishwasher arrived, I prepared the Frog Mini that everyone uses, and I tried running the dishwasher for the first time on the evening of the installation day. It used to take a while because I wasn't very good at Tetris, but after doing it every day, I’ve become incredibly fast now. I dislike the smell caused by food residue and the frequent cleaning of the strainer, so I pre-wash the dishes with cold water before putting them in (just enough to remove food scraps, leaving the grease on). Perhaps that is why the strainer cleaning alarm hasn't gone off yet, and there is absolutely no smell. Except for large pots and pans, it easily fits all the tableware for a meal for a family of three, including cooking, and the operating noise is comparable to everyday noise (it doesn't bother me at all when the TV is on in the living room or when I'm playing with my baby). Since the lid opens and hot steam escapes a few minutes before the dishwasher finishes, and moisture remains in that state for a day, I open the door wide and pull the drying rack outside before bed to maximize the natural drying effect, and then organize the dishes the next morning. (Smooth dishes and cups are completely dry, but moisture still remains in grooves or curved parts like food container lids, so I wipe them with a paper towel to finish.) Using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit unfamiliar, but I adapted quickly. Thinking, "This is why people call it a 'Do-Auntie'," I resented buying it so late, but at the same time, I congratulated myself for making the right purchase. I will summarize my thoughts after nearly three months. Pros: Dishwashing stress has disappeared (I used to multitask by washing dishes while cooking, but now I can just cook and use a lot of dishes without any burden; I just run the dishwasher at the end and I'm done!). My legs don't hurt as dishwashing time has shortened. The time my baby waits for me has decreased, and the time I spend playing with the baby has increased (I am so happy). I don't fight with my husband, I don't hate him, and he says his stress has decreased as well. Cons: The kitchen has become smaller. Whether it is an issue with the detergent or the dishwasher's cleaning power, I see white water stains (residual detergent?) in the small crevices (it is the same even if I break the detergent packet or add an extra rinse). Therefore, there is the hassle of double-washing (I am worried about the baby's dishes, so I often scrub them one more time with hot water before rinsing). If left as is after the cycle ends, the water does not dry at all. Overall review: I didn't notice any significant change in the maintenance costs (electricity, water) before and after getting the dishwasher, which I was worried about. (I didn't calculate it meticulously down to the unit of currency ^^;) It would be more convenient if it had a hot air dryer, but opening the door and taking out the drying rack before bed isn't a big hassle for me. Although the usable kitchen space has shrunk, organizing has actually become easier, making the kitchen look much neater. The extra hassle of rinsing the white spots visible in the crevices of the baby's food tray (suspected to be residual detergent) is bearable. It might be a detergent issue, so I plan to try switching it out sometime. I understand now why people recommend dishwashers. I was 8 years late, but I hope it doesn't take others that long—not the time spent welcoming a dishwasher. Since buying the dishwasher, my husband and I haven't fought once over the dishes. It has brought peace to our family, and it is no exaggeration to say it is the smartest purchase of the year! Above all, it is a truly grateful product that gifted me precious time to spend with my baby in the evenings. This is an honest review based on my experience using it for 3 months, so I hope it helps those who are currently considering buying one.

ㅠㅠ) 같은게 보인다 (세제를 쪼개도, 헹굼 추가해도 마찬가지예요...) 그래서 이중으로 세척하는 번거로움이 있다 ㅠㅠ (아기식기는 걱정되어 뜨거운 물로 한번 더 문질러서 헹굴때가 종종 있어요 ㅠㅠ)작동이 끝나고 그대로 두면 물이 전혀 마르지 않는다총평 : 우려했던 관리비 (전기세, 물세)는 식세기 전과 후에 큰 변화를 느끼지 못했어요~ (원단위까지 꼼꼼하게 따져보진 않았습니다 ^^;) 열풍건조가 되면 더 편하겠지만 자기전에 문열고 건조대 빼는게 저에게는 크게 힘들지 않아요~주방 사용공간은 좁아졌지만 오히려 정리정돈이 수월해지면서 주방이 깔끔해졌어요~ 아기식판틈에 보이는 하얀부분(잔류세제 의심)은 추가로 헹궈주는 번거로움은 견딜만 해요~ 세제 문제일수도 있으니 중간에 한번 바꿔보도록 하려구요~왜 주변에서 식세기를 추천하는지 알것같아요~ 저는 8년이나 늦었지만 다른분들은 오래 안걸리셨으면 좋겠네요 이모님 맞이하는 시간이요..^^식세기 구매 후에는 남편이랑 설거지 때문에 싸운적이 한번도 없어요~ 가족의 평화를 주었고 올해 가장 현명한 소비품이라고 해도 과언이 아니예요!!무엇보다도 저녁에 아기와 보내는 소중한 시간을 선물해준 정말 고마운 제품이랍니다~ 3개월간 사용하면서 느낀 솔직한 리뷰이니 현재 고민하시는 분들에게 도움이 되셨음 좋겠어요 ^^

Sentence (English): We purchased the GDT670SGVBB in March of 2024.
Comments (English): [ Gets The Job Done! ] || ---------------- || We purchased the GDT670SGVBB in March of 2024. To date, we have not had one single issue. I find this model to be very quite in most cases. There are times when it does become noisy, but to be perfectly honest, dish placement/ pot and pans can be a contributor to the noise factor. The capacity is adequate . Unfortunately, we couldn't go any larger because it would not fit the available space. One has to be creative is filling this dishwasher. I find the removable upper pull out rack helpful. At times I forget I have placed things there, and they end up getting washed twice in error. Door Locking mechanism. You can lock the controls, but why doesn't the door lock as well? I would think that this would be an important safety feature. Especially if you have young, curious children in the house hold. Soiled Dish Sensor: Does this really work? I have the same run time as I do when setting under Normal. I wouldn't say that this dishwasher is loaded with features, but is satisfies my needs. Filters: I recall the days, when you didn't need to worry about such a thing. But now a days, you do. I inspect and rinse the filters on a monthly basis. I cannot complain, at lease these filters are reusable. Stainless steel inside. As documented in many reviews, the material type is debatable. The material will stain, but can be cleaned by using mild soap. Or, I find that next load will remove what was there previously. Bluetooth/ WIFI Connectivity. This unit is designed to be WIFI ready. Which is odd for this day and age. Bluetooth connectivity is not a variable. You have to spend a little more to purchase the Optional (Requires part no. PBX23W00Y1). I find this way of connecting to the Internet cumbersome. We had sub contractors install this unit from a famous local hardware store. They had to come back twice because they neglected to level the machine properly. UGH! Performance: I have not pulled out a dirty dish and/ or utensil after a completed wash cycle. You need to provide enough space between dishes, and most of all utensils. I enjoy the fact that this machine supplies jets underneath the silverware basket. Control visibility. I believe it to be based on personnel preference. I like to see the time left to a complete cycle. Some may not.

Sentence (English): Since I was coming from a top-of-the-range Siemens appliance, the changes have been minimal in terms of service, but significant in terms of operation.
Comments (English): [ Meets expectations ] || ---------------- || Since I was coming from a top-of-the-range Siemens appliance, the changes have been minimal in terms of service, but significant in terms of operation. In terms of service, there are improvements in the number of programs, on-screen information, internal lighting, an extra cleaning area, the division of the outermost folding combs of the lower tray into two batches, the possibility of height adjustment with lateral tilting of the central basket without extra noise, improvements in all moving parts of the trays or baskets, better drying, automatic door opening, zeolites, and no increased energy consumption. Regarding noise, it does make noise when it's not too full, and some parts can move. What it does improve on compared to previous models that were top-of-the-range in their day is operation. Almost everything can be configured from the phone, but also from the appliance itself. In addition to several additional options for each program, it provides various information about the current program phase, remaining time, and consumption. The maintenance alerts are very useful. (We have a Series 8 washer-dryer and already know its benefits.) I miss information about zeolites, how they work, how to care for them, what to do, and how to use them. More information about new features would be appreciated. A larger rinse aid reservoir and another for soap or tablets, with a barcode reader, would be nice, so you can dispense just the right amount, just like the washing machine does. I really like the ability to turn off the external display and the placement of the buttons and control screen, which are hidden and inaccessible to children or accidentally when the appliance door is closed. The keypad on the top edge of the door is a great idea. Horizontally, they're easier to see and operate. The small screen next to the buttons is very helpful and allows for configuration without a phone. I also miss knowing how using options like Vario Speed, Extra Dry, and Extra Hygiene affect the machine's maintenance. To decide whether or not to use the options. Regarding the flexibility of the baskets and trays, it's so good and comprehensive that all dishwashers should be like this. Baskets as versatile as these should be mandatory. I won't name other brands, but one that costs twice as much and boasts a long lifespan without breakdowns (its name implies) turned out to be a piece of cake compared to this dishwasher or the previous Siemens, which still works perfectly after many years and will continue to do so. And most importantly: even with shorter programs, the dishes come out clean and dry. It cleans better than other brands, I can say that with absolute certainty.
Comments (Original): [ Cumple expectativas ] || ---------------- || Puesto que venía de un Siemens tope de gama en su día, los cambios han resultado mínimos en cuanto al servicio, pero significativos en el manejo.En el servicio, mejora la cantidad de programas, la información en pantalla, la luz interna, la zona de limpieza extra, la división en dos lotes de los peines abatibles más externos de la bandeja inferior, la posibilidad de ajuste de altura con inclinación lateral de la cesta central sin ruido extra, mejora en todas las partes móviles de las bandejas o cestas, mejor secado, apertura automática de la puerta, zeolitas, sin aumento de gasto energético.Sobre el ruido, sí hace ruido cuando no se llena demasiado y alguna pieza puede moverse. En lo que sí mejora respecto a modelos anteriores que fueron tope de gama en su día es en el manejo. Se puede configurar casi todo desde el teléfono, pero también desde el mismo aparato. Además de varias opciones adicionales en cada programa, proporciona diversa información sobre la fase de programa en que se encuentra, tiempo restante, consumo ...  Muy útil son los avisos de mantenimiento. (Tenemos lavadora-secadora serie 8 y ya conocemos sus ventajas).Echo de menos información sobre las zeolitas, cómo funcionan, cómo se cuidan, qué debemos hacer... Cómo usarlas. Se agradecería más información sobre las novedades.Estaría bien un depósito mayor de  abrillantador y otro de jabón o para pastillas, con lector de código de barras, para dosificar lo justo, tal como hace la lavadora.Me gusta mucho la posibilidad de apagar la pantalla exterior y la colocación de los botones y la pantalla de control, que quedan ocultos y no accesibles por niños o de forma involuntaria cuando el aparato tiene la puerta cerrada. Un acierto la botonera en el borde superior de la puerta. En horizontal son más fáciles de ver y de manejar. La pantalla pequeña  junto a los botones es de mucha ayuda además de permitir la configuración sin teléfono.También se echa de menos saber cómo influye en la conservación de la máquina el uso de opciones como vario speed, extra secado, extra higiene... Para decidir o no el uso que damos a las opciones.Sobre la flexibilidad en las cestas y bandejas, es tan buena y completa que todos los lavavajillas deberían ser así. Las cestas tan versátiles como estás deberían ser obligatorias.No voy a nombrar otras marcas, pero una que cuesta el doble y presume de durar mucho sin averías (su nombre significa eso) resultó ser una patata comparada con este lavavajillas o el anterior Siemens que sigue funcionando perfectamente tras muchísimos años y seguirá haciéndolo.Y lo más importante: incluso con programas más cortos la vajilla sale limpia y seca. Limpia mejor que otras marcas, esto puedo decirlo con toda certeza.

Comments (English): [ Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher Review ] || ---------------- || I was looking for the model to replace my original one that got fried by a lightening strike. I like the simplicity of the turn it on and go--wiifii? For a Dishwasher? NOT! The original had served me well. This one seemed the closest match. I did not want all the fancy bells and whistles, just clean dishes. This one is fine but I do have to say the original one seemed to have a better silverware tray. The difference in quality was notable so I kept the old try and use that with the new one. So far the dishes come out fine--occasionally there is one that comes out dirty. Also, this does not hold alot if you have a big family or need more room. But for me, it works. so far! I have had it a month with no issues. My only suggestion is pay attention to cleaning the filter and wands regularly. The first one I had an issue with leaking out the front and I cleaned everything and that fixed it. Also the simplicity of design allowed me to solve a problem myself when a cherry pit stopped the operation. I like that! Bringing back old-time simplicity and appliances of solid construction and function is a win win.

Sentence (English): I recently upgraded to the GE Profile 24" Top Control Smart Dishwasher and I couldn't be happier with the purchase.
Comments (English): [ Great product ] || ---------------- || I recently upgraded to the GE Profile 24" Top Control Smart Dishwasher and I couldn't be happier with the purchase. The first thing I noticed is how quiet it is—at 39 dBA, you can barely tell it's running. I've had conversations right next to it while it's on, and it's almost silent compared to my old dishwasher.The 3rd rack is a game changer. It's perfect for silverware, small utensils, and even things like measuring spoons that usually get lost in the main racks. The dedicated jet wash is also super handy—I use it for bottles, travel mugs, and glassware, and they come out spotless every time.The interior feels very spacious and well thought out. I can fit a surprising amount of dishes in one load, and everything dries really well thanks to the heated dry option. Plus, the stainless steel inside looks sleek and doesn't hold onto odors the way plastic tubs sometimes do.I also love the smart features. Comments (English): [ Very Disappointing ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher technically works, and washes dishes, but I was incredibly disappointed in it. Everything in our dishwasher is wet at the end of the load just like an average lower end dishwasher. I feel duped, and we are debating returning it. Sentence (English): I initially looked into a Samsung model, but the installation requirements were strict, so I ended up purchasing a different product from the same manufacturer.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that cleans well and increases time spent with family ] || ---------------- || I initially looked into a Samsung model, but the installation requirements were strict, so I ended up purchasing a different product from the same manufacturer. It is from the same manufacturer as the Samsung countertop dishwasher. Since it is a 6-place setting size, it is sufficient for a family of 3 to 4 people. It features automatic door opening drying and UV sterilization functions. The price range is around 400,000 to 500,000 won, offering great value for money. It has drain blades in the middle as well, and three sides are made of stainless steel (except the bottom). The interior is visible, so you can check if the blades are getting caught. Since purchasing from Coupang includes Rocket Delivery and installation services, I had absolutely no worries about delivery. I also added Coupang Safety Care insurance when making the payment. The technician came right on the scheduled date to install and test the unit, so I was able to start using it quickly. Looking at the key features: - 6-place capacity: It can store plates, soup bowls, cups, and cutlery after a meal. However, it is a bit cramped for putting multiple pots in at once. - Automatic door opening drying: When the dishwasher finishes, the door opens slightly to let the internal heat escape, preventing moisture buildup. Thanks to this, everything dries perfectly and stays fluffy. - UV Sterilization Function: Eliminates even bacteria remaining after washing, ensuring hygiene and peace of mind. - Ease of Operation: The buttons are simple, making it easy for anyone to use. While there aren't many washing cycles, it includes everything you need. - Noise: It is quieter than expected, so I was able to run it at night without any issues. It is a bit of a shame that there is no timer function, but I am still satisfied because the washing performance is good and it reduces dishwashing time. You must purchase dishwasher detergent along with the product to qualify for Rocket Delivery and Installation.
Comments (Original): [ 가족과 함께하는 시간이 늘어나는 세척 잘 되는 식세기 ] || ---------------- || 처음엔 삼성껄 알아봤는데 설치 조건이 까다로워서 같은 제조사의 다른 제품을 구매하게 됐습니다.삼성 카운터탑 식세기와 같은 제조사6인용 사이즈라서 3~4인 가족까지는 충분히 커버 가능자동문 열림 건조 + UV 살균 기능 탑재가격대도 40~50만 원 선이라 가성비 좋음배수날개가 중간에도 있고, 3면 스테인리스(바닥은 아님)내부가 보여서 날개 걸리는지 확인 가능쿠팡에서 구매하면 로켓 배송 + 설치 서비스가 같이 제공되기 때문에 배송 걱정은 전혀 없었어요.결제할 때 쿠팡 안심케어 보험도 함께 넣었습니다기사님이 예약일 바로 와주셔서 설치해주고 테스트하고 가주시니까 빠르게 써볼 수 있어요.주요 기능을 보면- 6인용 용량 : 접시, 국그릇, 컵, 수저 정도는 한 끼 식사 후 모두 수납 가능. 다만 냄비는 한 번에 여러 개 넣기엔 약간 좁아요.- 자동문 열림 건조 : 세척기 끝나면 문이 살짝 열리면서 내부 열기가 빠져나와 습기가 차지 않아요. 덕분에 뽀송뽀송하게 건조됩니다.- UV 살균 기능 : 세척 후 남아 있는 세균까지 잡아줘서 위생적으로 안심.- 조작 편의성 : 버튼기 단순해서 누구나 쉽게 사용 가능. 세척 코스가 많진 않지만 필요한 건 다 들어있어요- 소음 : 생각보다 조용해서 밤에도 부담 없이 돌릴 수 있었습니다.예약기능 없는게 약간 아쉽지만 그래도 세척 기능 좋은데 설거지 시간 줄어들어 만족합니다.구매하실 때 식세기 세제도 같이 구매하셔야 로켓배송로켓설치에 맞춰서 사용할 수 있어요.

It is from the same manufacturer as the Samsung countertop dishwasher. Since it is a 6-place setting size, it is sufficient for a family of 3 to 4 people. It features automatic door opening drying and UV sterilization functions. The price range is around 400,000 to 500,000 won, offering great value for money. It has drain blades in the middle as well, and three sides are made of stainless steel (except the bottom). The interior is visible, so you can check if the blades are getting caught. Since purchasing from Coupang includes Rocket Delivery and installation services, I had absolutely no worries about delivery. I also added Coupang Safety Care insurance when making the payment. The technician came right on the scheduled date to install and test the unit, so I was able to start using it quickly. Looking at the key features: - 6-place capacity: It can store plates, soup bowls, cups, and cutlery after a meal. However, it is a bit cramped for putting multiple pots in at once. - Automatic door opening drying: When the dishwasher finishes, the door opens slightly to let the internal heat escape, preventing moisture buildup. Thanks to this, everything dries perfectly and stays fluffy. - UV Sterilization Function: Eliminates even bacteria remaining after washing, ensuring hygiene and peace of mind. - Ease of Operation: The buttons are simple, making it easy for anyone to use. While there aren't many washing cycles, it includes everything you need. - Noise: It is quieter than expected, so I was able to run it at night without any issues. It is a bit of a shame that there is no timer function, but I am still satisfied because the washing performance is good and it reduces dishwashing time. You must purchase dishwasher detergent along with the product to qualify for Rocket Delivery and Installation.
Comments (Original): [ 가족과 함께하는 시간이 늘어나는 세척 잘 되는 식세기 ] || ---------------- || 처음엔 삼성껄 알아봤는데 설치 조건이 까다로워서 같은 제조사의 다른 제품을 구매하게 됐습니다.삼성 카운터탑 식세기와 같은 제조사6인용 사이즈라서 3~4인 가족까지는 충분히 커버 가능자동문 열림 건조 + UV 살균 기능 탑재가격대도 40~50만 원 선이라 가성비 좋음배수날개가 중간에도 있고, 3면 스테인리스(바닥은 아님)내부가 보여서 날개 걸리는지 확인 가능쿠팡에서 구매하면 로켓 배송 + 설치 서비스가 같이 제공되기 때문에 배송 걱정은 전혀 없었어요.결제할 때 쿠팡 안심케어 보험도 함께 넣었습니다기사님이 예약일 바로 와주셔서 설치해주고 테스트하고 가주시니까 빠르게 써볼 수 있어요.주요 기능을 보면- 6인용 용량 : 접시, 국그릇, 컵, 수저 정도는 한 끼 식사 후 모두 수납 가능. 다만 냄비는 한 번에 여러 개 넣기엔 약간 좁아요.- 자동문 열림 건조 : 세척기 끝나면 문이 살짝 열리면서 내부 열기가 빠져나와 습기가 차지 않아요. 덕분에 뽀송뽀송하게 건조됩니다.- UV 살균 기능 : 세척 후 남아 있는 세균까지 잡아줘서 위생적으로 안심.- 조작 편의성 : 버튼기 단순해서 누구나 쉽게 사용 가능. 세척 코스가 많진 않지만 필요한 건 다 들어있어요- 소음 : 생각보다 조용해서 밤에도 부담 없이 돌릴 수 있었습니다.예약기능 없는게 약간 아쉽지만 그래도 세척 기능 좋은데 설거지 시간 줄어들어 만족합니다.구매하실 때 식세기 세제도 같이 구매하셔야 로켓배송로켓설치에 맞춰서 사용할 수 있어요.

Sentence (English): It feels like a mountain of dishes disappears in an instant.
Comments (English): [ Dish Lady is the Best: Top 3 Dishwasher Recommendations ] || ---------------- || It feels like a mountain of dishes disappears in an instant. In the past, seeing the pile of dishes after a meal used to make me sigh, but since getting this dishwasher after moving, my quality of life has truly changed. First of all, all the Coupang customer service representatives were kind, and the technician was also incredibly friendly. They carefully protected the floor to prevent scratches during installation and timed it perfectly. They even complimented how pretty our dishwasher is, saying it looks beautiful since ivory, white, and beige are popular colors these days! I wanted the stainless steel color, and I really love it! Also, perhaps because it is a 14-place setting model, there is plenty of room even when I put everything in at once, and plates and pots fit in neatly. It doesn't just wash things adequately; it removes all the grease, leaving them sparkling clean every time I take them out, which I found amazing. Another great thing is that it is almost completely silent. It doesn't bother me even when running it late at night, and since it runs softly, it doesn't cause any inconvenience even when the house is quiet. The interior is also neatly designed, allowing me to freely arrange plates and cups according to their size and height, and having a separate compartment for cutlery makes organization easy. Honestly, I think these subtle details make a significant difference every time I use it. Also, you don't have to worry too much about choosing detergent; since the performance is so good, I've rarely had any residue or stains left behind just by using standard dishwasher detergent. The hot drying function is also a surprisingly satisfying feature, allowing you to take dishes out and put them in the cupboard right away! It eliminates damp dish odors in the summer and reduces concerns about fogging in the winter. To sum it up? Being a 14-place setting, there is plenty of storage space. It is surprisingly quiet with almost no noise. The cleaning power removes even grease completely. It is convenient because the drying is thorough. Sentence (English): This product (DW90F89T0USRAA) was very difficult to install.
Comments (English): [ Awful install but decent product ] || ---------------- || This product (DW90F89T0USRAA) was very difficult to install. it does not come ready to install right out of the box you will need a $13 dishwasher wiring kit from Home Depot. The drain tube is very shot making it difficult to connect unless your garbage disposal is really close. The provided instructions are not very clear. The water inlet valve does not seem to be standard to existing dish washer connection so the fit is very tight and expect a lot of leaking. Finally the 2025 Samsung Dishwasher Ready2Fit Guarantee Offer is not a thing. They advertise $300 guarantee to make sure this dishwasher fits, not true. When you read the details, they say they will provide only $50. This will not fit a standard height counter and the adjustments for the feet are only in the front so you cannot adjust too much without changing the balance of the product. We replaces a KitchenAid KDTM354DSS4 which fit the space perfectly in both height and width. The KitchenAid was a replacement to the contractor original product which also fit. The Samsung product was too wide. I had to cut away come of the cabinetry trim to get the dishwasher to fit. The "Ready to Fit" is not at all ready, even with adjusting the feet as much as I could there is still a 2" gap between the dishwasher and the bottom of my counter. I have worked as as a carpenter and an electrician and have been working in IT for 30 years. Not only did this take my wife and I 3 hours to install it took another two hours to sync the wireless to the Smart things app. The instruction for syncing this device to the smart thing app was also severely lacking. It should sync automatically with the app but if it does not then you have to reset the dishwasher several time to release the mac address and or partial sync with the app. Put the dishwasher in "AP" mode (access Point) and reset it again or just to get it to broad case wirelessly. Seriously this was a major pain. I finally for it to stop leaking and god the product installed with the app functional and the product works very well so far, But this was an awful experience and I will have to go back and further modify the cabinet to get the fit to appear seamless. One last note the rubber gasket that goes around the dishwasher to cover the space between the cabinet is not sufficient and stops short of going all the way around so there will be gaps there as well on both the right and left side near the bottom. Too much to pay for a product that falls short and doesn't think of everything.

Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher to replace our old one.
Comments (English): [ Needs a new design ] || ---------------- || Bought this dishwasher to replace our old one. Didn't really read reviews first, but probably should have. Many have mentioned bottom rack issues and drying issues. I did experience the bottom rack having issues. The dividers where you put the plates or larger items kept falling over. So, then the whole stack of dirty plates would tip over. I tried everything to get the dividers to lock into place but they kept falling. Since I had already installed the dishwasher, I ended up having to use the bottom rack from my old machine. I had to change the wheels on the rack, but luckily it worked! The racks that come with this model are also pretty small! We did enjoy the top rack for utensils and stuff. Don't normally use drying feature so can't comment on that. The dishwasher does appear to work well once you make some modifications. And, is pretty quiet when running. If you're not handy, I would not recommend getting this model.

Sentence (English): I'm very happy with the Bosch 800 model SHX78CM5N I bought it to replace my 6 year old $1200 Kitchen Aid model KDTM404ESS, the one with three 3-armed spinners on a power driven main arm.
Comments (English): [ New Bosch 800 works great ] || ---------------- || I'm very happy with the Bosch 800 model SHX78CM5N I bought it to replace my 6 year old $1200 Kitchen Aid model KDTM404ESS, the one with three 3-armed spinners on a power driven main arm. It washed great but the second breakdown was too much. Interestingly, when I bought the Kitchen Aid, I wanted a Bosch. We told the salesmen about our square plates. He told us his square plates didnt work in the Bosch and recommended the Kitchen Aid. This time, we took our plates with us and they fit the Bosch fine. However, like everyone else, figuring out how to fully load the 800 has been a chore. I watched a dozen videos and read the manuals, not much help there. After reading Reddit posts I figured I'd have to work it out myself. Besides the large square plates (almost 13 inches wide), our set comes with two types of squarish bowls  one deeper than the other. These bowls were the problems. It seemed that the deep dish bowls had to go into the middle rack, just like in my Kitchen Aid. After some fussing, I lowered the tines in the bottom rack, put the regular bowls in them upright, facing the back. Six fit in easily in one column, another 6 would fit in the second column (see the picture). The large (and small) plates were on the back tines, still room for the silverware basket, which I eventually decided not to use in favor of the upper third rack. But would the bowls clean in that upright position? I baked stone-ground mustard into them via the microwave, also on some of the plates. Success! I tried my silverware in the top silverware rack, coating them with peanut butter, and they came out clean. The bottom rack offers flexibility for bowls, baking sheets, and other large things. The only complaint I have is with the app. It is overly complex (and I'm a retired computer science professor). I'm still struggling to start it with a delay.

Sentence (English): Replaced a 15 year old contractor grade dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Worth the Cost? ] || ---------------- || Replaced a 15 year old contractor grade dishwasher. The old one cleaned dishes fine but the dish rack vynil covering was worn and the rack was rusting leaving marks on our dishes. A replacement is no longer available. Plastics did not dry but the biggest problem was that it was very noisy. We purchased the 800 Series for its claims of quietness and drying ability along with the Bosch name for reliability. It came with a third rack as did all the other dish washers in its price range. This was new to us. It seemed like good idea. We found that putting flatware in the little slots was rather fiddly and time consuming. We tried to use it for a month and then gave up and went back to putting the flatware in the holder in the bottom rack. The other issue was that the top rack doesn't have its own spray bar. the spray has to go up through the second rack dishes, and then through the rather dense third rack to get to the flatware resulting in rather spotty cleaning. The third rack seems to be a fancy rather useless affectation. The wine stem holders on the second rack won't accept any wineglass stem that we own. All of the little flip up shelf guides are useless advertising glitz. No matter the setting plastics do not dry and any little depression or lip will require hand drying. Which brings up the fact that there are so many options you have to have an app on your phone to adjust them all. Who needs that? Our old one had a Rinse cycle, Normal cycle, Heavy and Pots and Pans cycles. Who needs more? On the positive side, it does clean the dishes just as good as the old one and is very quite.

Sentence (English): The first kitchen appliance I bought when I moved was this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It also goes well with the kitchen interior. ] || ---------------- || The first kitchen appliance I bought when I moved was this dishwasher. I trusted the positive reviews, so I bought it, and after using it, I understand why everyone recommended it. First of all, it's spacious enough to seat 14 people, so I can easily fit all the dishes for a family of three, as well as pots and pans. This has significantly reduced the stress of washing dishes. I'm also very satisfied with its cleaning power. Even greasy plates and glasses are cleaned thoroughly, leaving everything feeling fluffy when I take it out. The drying function is also excellent, so there are virtually no water stains and it's ready to be stored away. However, there are a few drawbacks. Because it's built-in, the installation process was a bit cumbersome, and I had to coordinate the installer's schedule, which was a bit inconvenient. It's also large, so I thought it might be out of place in a small kitchen. The price point is definitely an investment, so it's not something I'd consider a light purchase. Still, overall, it's a very satisfying choice. Eliminating the three times a day I spent washing dishes has dramatically improved my quality of life. I highly recommend it, especially for families with children or dual-income households. It blends well with kitchen decor and is a joy to look at.
Comments (Original): [ 주방 인테리어랑도 잘 어울려요 ] || ---------------- || 이사하면서 주방 가전에 제일 먼저 들인 게 바로 이 식기세척기예요. 워낙 후기가 좋아서 믿고 샀는데, 실제로 써보니 왜 다들 추천하는지 알겠더라구요. 일단 14인용이라 크기가 넉넉해서 하루 세 식구 쓰는 그릇은 물론, 냄비나 프라이팬까지 한 번에 넣어도 여유가 있어요. 그 덕에 설거지 스트레스가 정말 확 줄었어요. 세척력도 만족스러워요. 기름기 있는 접시나 유리컵도 뽀득하게 세척돼서 꺼낼 때마다 뽀송뽀송한 느낌이 들어요. 건조 기능도 좋아서 물자국 거의 없고, 바로 수납해도 될 정도예요.  다만 아쉬운 점도 있어요. 빌트인이다 보니 설치 과정이 조금 번거롭고, 설치 기사님 일정도 조율해야 해서 바로 사용할 수 없었던 점이 살짝 불편했어요. 또 사이즈가 커서 소형 주방에는 무리일 수 있다는 생각이 들었어요. 가격대도 아무래도 투자라고 생각해야 하는 수준이라, 가볍게 구매하기는 어렵구요.  그래도 전체적으로는 정말 만족스러운 선택이었어요. 하루 세 번 설거지하던 시간이 통째로 줄어드니 삶의 질이 달라졌다고 할까요? 특히 아이 있는 집이나 맞벌이 가정에는 강력 추천하고 싶어요. 주방 인테리어랑도 잘 어울려서 보는 즐거움까지 있네요.

We live in a family of three. Washing dishes is a hassle, so I've always wanted to get a dishwasher, but our small kitchen hasn't made it a viable option. As a Coupang Experience Group member, I was able to try out a mini dishwasher, and I was torn between a 3-person and a 6-person model. For families like ours with 1-4 people and a small kitchen, I recommend the 3-person Mydia window-mounted UV dishwasher. It's not overly large, so it's perfect for our small kitchen! It's not a stand-alone unit, so you can place it wherever you want, which is a huge plus. Despite its compact size, it offers excellent performance and I'm extremely satisfied with it. You can choose the water supply method you need: either install a water supply kit or provide your own. Drainage is also easy to install, as there's no need to drill holes. General. Powerful. It's divided into various courses such as low temperature, boiling water/sterilization, simple, and rinse/dry, so you can freely choose the course you want depending on the type and level of dishwashing, and the type of dishes. Above all, my favorite thing is the automatic door opening. I usually run it after breakfast, go to work, run it after dinner, and don't pay attention to it, so the automatic door opening function is very precious. Secondly, the operation is simple and intuitive, so it's enough for my parents to use. It has just the right functions and easy operation, so anyone can use it. Most importantly, the washing power is beyond words. It can wash the oily dishes that I just lightly removed after eating mapo tofu, the dishes that I just had jjajangmyeon with stains, and the dishes that were stained with fish oil, all of them were washed cleanly. The regular cycle time of 1 hour and 40 minutes is good, and the simple cycle of about 40 minutes is more than enough. I wonder why I only started using a dishwasher now. I also really like that the front is glass so I can see how well the dishwasher is washing, and that it's versatile enough to sterilize not only with boiling water but also with UV sterilization when needed. The dishes are enough for a family of three to put in soup, rice, and side dish dishes. I highly recommend it to anyone considering it :) I bought the mini solid detergent from Coupang. Half a bottle is enough, and one bottle washes and rinses thoroughly without overflowing.
Comments (Original): [ 1~4인 가족용으로 딱인 만능 식기세척기 추천합니다. ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.3인 식구가 사는 가정입니다.설거지가 번거로워서 언젠가 식기세척기 하나 들여야지, 싶다가도 좁은 주방 때문에 마땅치가 않았습니다.마침 쿠팡체험단으로 미니 식기세척기를 사용해볼수 있어서 3인용과 6인용 중 고민했는데요.저희처럼 1~4인용, 주방이 좁은 가정의 경우 3인용 마이디어 창문형 UV 식기세척기 추천합니다.일단 크기가 큰 편이 아니라서 좁은 주방에 올려놓고 써도 충분합니다! 설치형이 아니라서 자유롭게 원하는 위치에 올려둘 수 있어서 압도적으로 좋습니다.작은 크기에 비해 뛰어난 성능으로 부족함 없이 너무나 만족하며 사용 중입니다.급수는 급수 키트로 설치하거나 직접 급수해주면 되기에 필요한 방법으로 선택하시면 됩니다. 배수도 구멍 뚫을 필요 없어서 설치 간편합니다.일반. 강력. 저온, 열탕/살균, 간편, 헹굼/건조 등 여러가지 코스로 나뉘어져 있어서 설거지 종류나 정도에 따라, 식기의 종류에 따라 원하는 코스로 자유롭게 선택 가능합니다.무엇보다 가장 마음에 드는 건 자동 문열림이에요. 보통 아침 먹고나서 돌리고 출근하고, 저녁먹고 나서 돌리고 신경 끄고 있다보니 자동 문열림 기능이 매우 소중해요.두번째로 마음에 드는건 조작이 간편하고 직관적이라 부모님 쓰시기에도 충분하다는 겁니다.딱 필요한 기능, 쉬운 조작으로 누구나 사용하기 좋아요.무엇보다 가장 중요한 점. 세척 능력이야 말해 뭐해요.마파두부 먹고 나서 가볍게 건더기만 제거한 기름기 있는 그릇도, 얼룩덜룩 짜장밥 먹고 난 그릇도, 생선 기름 묻은 식기도 모두 뽀득뽀득 깨끗하게 세척해주네요. 일반 1시간 40분도 좋고, 간편 약 40분도 충분히 세척 가능합니다. 왜 식기세척기를 이제야 써보나 싶어요. 앞면이 유리라 세척이 잘 돌아가는지 볼 수 있다는 점도, 소독이 필요할 경우 열탕 뿐만 아니라 UV 소독까지 가능한 다재다능 식기세척기란 점도 매우 마음에 듭니다.그릇은 3인 식구가 국, 밥, 반찬 그릇들 이렇게 넣기에 충분합니다. 고려하시는 분들께 강력 추천해요 :)세제는 쿠팡에서 파는 미니 고체 세제 샀어요. 반개로도 충분하고 한 개로도 넘침 없이 깨끗히 세척, 헹굼됩니다.

Sentence (English): Overall, I think the DB476XT dishwasher is a good appliance: it has modern and useful technologies, such as the steam function, which was initially one of the points that most attracted me.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, but with points that could be improved in i ] || ---------------- || Overall, I think the DB476XT dishwasher is a good appliance: it has modern and useful technologies, such as the steam function, which was initially one of the points that most attracted me. However, steam is only available in the programs that consume the most electricity, which raises questions about how efficiency is actually calculated to obtain the A label, since in real-life use, it may not be used as much. Another aspect that convinced me when purchasing it was the sliding door. But this is where I encountered the biggest problem: installation is quite complicated, even with previous experience, and it requires the cabinet door to be at least 72 cm in size for the sliding system to work. My doors are 70 cm, and in contrast, I never had problems installing them with other brands such as Balay or Teka. The worst thing is that, even if you manage to adapt it, the sliding door itself requires the panel to be longer and ends up hitting the baseboard. Even the manual recommends trimming the baseboard, something that seems completely illogical to me in a system that is supposedly designed precisely to avoid this type of inconvenience. Furthermore, LG is offering an interesting promotion: a free year of Finish products for those who purchase this model and write a review. So far, so good, as participating stores are usually available. However, when checking the list, only LG's online store appears, no others. I bought it at MediaMarkt and I could understand why it wasn't included, but if the promotion only applies to the LG website, they should clearly indicate this in the advertisement. I understand that they can't include a complete list in the image, but if it's actually just one store, I think it's an important detail they should specify. In short: a dishwasher with good technology and cleaning results, but with an impractical door design and a promotion that generates confusion due to the lack of transparency in the participating stores.
Comments (Original): [ Buen lavavajillas, pero con puntos mejorables en i ] || ---------------- || En general, el lavavajillas DB476XT me parece un buen electrodoméstico: cuenta con tecnologías modernas y útiles, como la función de vapor, que en principio fue uno de los puntos que más me atrajo. Sin embargo, el vapor solo está disponible en los programas que más electricidad consumen, lo que hace cuestionarse cómo se calcula realmente la eficiencia para obtener la etiqueta A, ya que en el uso real puede que no se aproveche tanto.Otro aspecto que me convenció a la hora de comprarlo fue la puerta deslizante. Pero aquí es donde encontré el mayor problema: la instalación resulta bastante complicada incluso teniendo experiencia previa, y exige que la puerta del mueble mida al menos 72 cm para que funcione el sistema deslizante. Mis puertas son de 70 cm y, en cambio, con otras marcas como Balay o Teka nunca tuve problemas para instalarlas.Lo peor es que, aunque logres adaptarlo, la propia puerta deslizante obliga a que el panel sea más largo y termine golpeando el zócalo. Incluso en el manual recomiendan recortar el zócalo, algo que me parece totalmente ilógico en un sistema que se supone diseñado precisamente para evitar este tipo de inconvenientes.Además, LG ofrece una promoción interesante: un año gratis de productos Finish para quienes adquieran este modelo y hagan una reseña. Hasta aquí todo bien, ya que suele ser normal que haya establecimientos adheridos. Sin embargo, al revisar la lista solo aparece la tienda online de LG, ninguna otra. Yo lo compré en MediaMarkt y podría entender que no estuviera incluida, pero si la promoción solo aplica a la web de LG, deberían indicarlo claramente en la propia publicidad. Entiendo que no puedan poner una lista completa en la imagen, pero si en realidad es una sola tienda, creo que es un detalle importante que deberían especificar.En resumen: un lavavajillas con buena tecnología y resultados de limpieza, pero con un diseño de puerta poco práctico y una promoción que genera confusión por la falta de transparencia en los establecimientos adheridos.

Comments (English): The product has only been on the market a short time. I have other Hisense products that have been good. Our dishwasher stopped, so we looked at this one rather than repair.
