Biggest bottom basket ever, simple to load. Brilliant. Middle basket is a little difficult to get the hang of loading. Not enough cup & glass space, but everything does fit in. The cutlery basket up top is deeper than the previous machine, making cutlery very easy to load. Movable sides need adjusting back to the sides from time to time, but like the bottom basket, it's huge. It takes large handle knives easily. The detergent dispenser is deep so measure detergent powder carefully, and it holds tabs easily. The rinse aid dispenser is huge. Easily the best to fill that I've ever used. 10/10. Shutting the door is easier than our last. There is a fast program that works well, but we did one load and it wasn't remarkable. However, the normal cycle using the Super Dry is just GOLD. Never have we had a dishwasher that dries plastics. Yes, you heard that right, it dries plastics. Unbelievable. At around $800, it was very competitive. Installation was easy. Appearance excellent, control panel is simple, but difficult to read with light graphics, but not a big deal. Best door handle ever. Biggest bottom basket ever, simple to load. Brilliant. Middle basket is a little difficult to get the hang of loading. Not enough cup & glass space, but everything does fit in. The cutlery basket up top is deeper than the previous machine, making cutlery very easy to load. Movable sides need adjusting back to the sides from time to time, but like the bottom basket, it's huge. It takes large handle knives easily. The detergent dispenser is deep so measure detergent powder carefully, and it holds tabs easily. The rinse aid dispenser is huge. Easily the best to fill that I've ever used. 10/10. Shutting the door is easier than our last. There is a fast program that works well, but we did one load and it wasn't remarkable. However, the normal cycle using the Super Dry is just GOLD. Never have we had a dishwasher that dries plastics. Yes, you heard that right, it dries plastics. Unbelievable. Program takes 2.34hrs and the door pops open with 1.33hrs to go and gives a ding ding sound to tell you its open. Leave it open till the next ding ding, and plastics are dry. Thumbs up. This machine is probably the quietest ever. Even the fill is hard to hear. Opening the door to load is easy even with long fingernails (wife). Score 9/10.

SK매직 미니 식기세척기는 용량이 조금 작아서 1~2인 가구에 최적화돼 있지만 그만큼 많은 양을 한 번에 세척하기엔 부족할 수 있죠.  이런 여러 제품들 사이에서 삼성 BESPOKE 카운터탑 6인용은 디자인적 만족감이 크고 용량이 적당해서 균형감이 있다는 게 장점이에요. 만약 다른 걸 하나 추천해야 한다면 저는 LG 디오스 카운터탑 6인용도 괜찮다고 봐요. 이건 세척력이나 건조 성능이 우수해서 만족도가 높은데 대신 가격 부담이 있을 수 있다는 점 참고하면 돼요.  핵심 장점 정리  방문 설치로 편리하게 바로 사용 가능  6인용 용량으로 적당한 크기  화이트글래스 디자인으로 인테리어 효과  강력한 세척력으로 기름기와 얼룩 제거 탁월  다양한 세척 모드로 상황 맞게 사용 가능  저는 지인 한 명이 집에 와서 세척된 컵 보고 \'야 이거 새 거 샀냐??\' 라고 물어봤을 때 괜히 뿌듯했어요 ㅋㅋㅋ.

But the installer took immediate action, making everything easy. He even explained the product's features, making it easy for even a beginner to use. But this product simply wiped them away. Even the bowls with rice cakes came out clean, making me exclaim, "This is the best!" The difference in results was especially noticeable when washing stainless steel pots and glass cups. The glass cups came out clear and shiny, without a single cloudy stain or smudge, as if they were brand new. Have you ever been annoyed by water stains on your glass? I used to get secretly stressed about that too, but now that problem is completely gone. Duration of Use and Satisfaction: I've had this product for about three weeks now, and I've been using it every single day. The more I use it, the more I regret buying it. Washing time has been reduced, my hands have gotten less chapped, and my quality of life has definitely improved. I usually run it twice a day, and it's not too noisy, so I can use it even late at night without any worries. If you're worried about noise between floors because you live in an apartment, you can rest assured. Product Ingredients and Features Design: Clean and stylish thanks to the white glass material Capacity: Perfect for a family of six or even one or two people Type: Countertop-mounted, no built-in installation required Washing Mode: Various options, including powerful, normal, and economy modes Maintenance: Easy hygiene thanks to the internal automatic cleaning function. This is the key! It offers the perfect combination of easy installation, powerful cleaning power, and a luxurious design. Comparison of Similar Products When comparing similar dishwasher models, the LG Dios Countertop 6-Person model has a simple design yet great functionality, but it's a bit pricey. The SK Magic Mini Dishwasher has a slightly smaller capacity, making it ideal for one or two-person households, but it might not be enough to wash a lot of items at once. Among these options, the Samsung BESPOKE Countertop 6-Person stands out for its pleasing design and ample capacity, creating a sense of balance. If I had to recommend something else, I think the LG Dios Countertop 6-seater is also good. This one has excellent cleaning and drying performance, so I am very satisfied, but you should keep in mind that the price may be a bit burdensome. If you're worried about noise between floors because you live in an apartment, you can rest assured. This one has excellent cleaning and drying performance, so I am very satisfied, but you should keep in mind that the price may be a bit burdensome. Sentence (English): I got to use the MyDeer Countertop App-Linked Auto-Open 6-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team, and after using it for a few days, I feel like my quality of life has been upgraded.
Comments (English): [ I think I know why people use dishwashers~! ] || ---------------- || I got to use the MyDeer Countertop App-Linked Auto-Open 6-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team, and after using it for a few days, I feel like my quality of life has been upgraded. First, let me start with the size and installation. I expected it to be quite large for 6 people, but it actually sits perfectly on the kitchen countertop. Even though my kitchen isn't very spacious, it didn't feel overwhelming, and its simple design blends well with my interior. Installation wasn't difficult either. Simply connect the included hoses and follow the instructions. No complicated construction or special installation was required, so I was able to set it up quickly on my own. Now that I've actually used it, what I'm most pleased with is its cleaning power. Even greasy frying pans, soup-stained rice bowls, and stubbornly stained glass cups sparkled thanks to the high-temperature cleaning. When I wash dishes by hand, no matter how hard I try, water stains or fine grease can still remain. But with the dishwasher, those worries are gone. The auto-open door feature is especially convenient. After the wash is complete, the door opens automatically, releasing hot steam and allowing the interior to dry naturally, eliminating the inconvenience of dripping when removing dishes. This feature alone provided a distinct difference from conventional dishwashers. Another great feature was the app integration. Since I'm usually out and about, I find it inconvenient to wash dishes when I get home, but with the app, I can remotely control the machine and start the wash before I get home. Checking the remaining wash time on the app was also surprisingly convenient. It was quieter than I expected, and it wasn't too noisy, even at night, so I could use it at any time. It also reportedly uses less electricity and water than I expected, which should help reduce my electricity and water bills in the long run. After using it for a few days, I realized this product isn't just a machine that does the dishes for me; it's an appliance that changes my lifestyle. It's especially perfect for dual-income families with limited time, seniors who struggle with hand washing, and single- or two-person households. It significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes, saving time and energy. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with this product, and it even made me wonder, "Why didn't I just get a dishwasher before?" It offers a low barrier to entry for first-time dishwashers, and I'm completely satisfied with its performance and convenience, making it a highly recommended product.
Comments (Original): [ 왜 사람들이 식기세척기를 쓰는지를 알거 같아요~!! ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단을 통해 마이디어 카운터탑 앱연동 자동문열림 6인용 식기세척기를 사용하게 되었는데, 며칠 동안 써보니 삶의 질이 한 단계 업그레이드된 느낌입니다.  먼저 크기와 설치 부분부터 말씀드리면, 6인용이라 꽤 클 거라 생각했는데 실제로 보니 주방 상판 위에 올려두고 쓰기에 딱 적당했습니다. 주방 공간이 넓지 않은 편인데도 크게 부담되지 않았고, 디자인도 심플해서 인테리어와 잘 어울렸습니다. 설치도 어렵지 않았어요. 동봉된 호스와 설명서대로 연결만 하면 되고, 복잡한 공사나 별도 시공이 필요 없어서 혼자서도 금방 세팅할 수 있었습니다.  본격적으로 사용해보니 제일 만족스러운 건 역시 세척력입니다. 기름기 가득한 프라이팬, 국물 자국이 남아 있던 밥그릇, 얼룩이 잘 지워지지 않는 유리컵까지도 고온 세척 덕분에 반짝반짝해졌습니다. 손으로 일일이 설거지할 때는 아무리 깨끗이 닦아도 물자국이나 미세한 기름기가 남아있을 때가 있었는데, 식기세척기를 돌려놓으니 그런 걱정이 없어졌습니다.  특히 자동문열림 기능은 생각보다 훨씬 편리했습니다. 세척이 끝나면 문이 스스로 열리면서 뜨거운 증기가 빠져나가고 내부가 자연스럽게 건조되니, 식기를 꺼낼 때 물방울이 뚝뚝 떨어지는 불편함이 없었습니다. 이 기능 하나만으로도 기존 식기세척기들과 차별화된 만족감을 느낄 수 있었습니다.  또 하나 좋았던 점은 앱 연동 기능이었어요. 평소에 외출할 일이 많아 집에 들어와서 설거지를 해야 하는 게 귀찮았는데, 앱으로 원격 조작을 할 수 있으니 집에 오기 전에 미리 세척을 시작해둘 수 있었습니다. 앱에서 남은 세척 시간을 확인할 수 있는 것도 은근히 편리했습니다.  소음도 예상보다 조용했습니다. 밤에 돌려도 크게 거슬리지 않을 정도라서 시간에 구애받지 않고 사용할 수 있었습니다. 전력이나 물 사용량도 생각보다 적게 든다고 해서, 장기적으로는 전기세·수도세 절감에도 도움이 될 것 같았습니다.  며칠 사용하면서 느낀 건, 이 제품은 단순히 ‘설거지를 대신해주는 기계’가 아니라 생활 패턴 자체를 바꿔주는 가전이라는 점이었습니다. 특히 맞벌이 가정처럼 시간이 부족한 집이나, 손 설거지를 힘들어하는 어르신, 1~2인 가구에도 딱 알맞다고 생각합니다. 설거지 스트레스가 확 줄어들고, 시간과 에너지를 아낄 수 있으니까요.  전체적으로 만족도가 굉장히 높은 제품이었고, ‘왜 이제야 식기세척기를 썼을까’ 하는 생각이 들 정도였습니다. 처음으로 식기세척기를 사용해보는 분들에게도 진입장벽이 낮고, 성능이나 편의성 면에서도 충분히 만족스러워서 적극 추천할 만한 제품입니다.

Sentence (English): Simply connect the included hoses and follow the instructions.
Comments (English): [ I think I know why people use dishwashers~! ] || ---------------- || I got to use the MyDeer Countertop App-Linked Auto-Open 6-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team, and after using it for a few days, I feel like my quality of life has been upgraded. First, let me start with the size and installation. I expected it to be quite large for 6 people, but it actually sits perfectly on the kitchen countertop. Even though my kitchen isn't very spacious, it didn't feel overwhelming, and its simple design blends well with my interior. Installation wasn't difficult either. Simply connect the included hoses and follow the instructions. No complicated construction or special installation was required, so I was able to set it up quickly on my own. Now that I've actually used it, what I'm most pleased with is its cleaning power. Even greasy frying pans, soup-stained rice bowls, and stubbornly stained glass cups sparkled thanks to the high-temperature cleaning. When I wash dishes by hand, no matter how hard I try, water stains or fine grease can still remain. But with the dishwasher, those worries are gone. The auto-open door feature is especially convenient. After the wash is complete, the door opens automatically, releasing hot steam and allowing the interior to dry naturally, eliminating the inconvenience of dripping when removing dishes. This feature alone provided a distinct difference from conventional dishwashers. Another great feature was the app integration. Since I'm usually out and about, I find it inconvenient to wash dishes when I get home, but with the app, I can remotely control the machine and start the wash before I get home. Checking the remaining wash time on the app was also surprisingly convenient. It was quieter than I expected, and it wasn't too noisy, even at night, so I could use it at any time. It also reportedly uses less electricity and water than I expected, which should help reduce my electricity and water bills in the long run. After using it for a few days, I realized this product isn't just a machine that does the dishes for me; it's an appliance that changes my lifestyle. It's especially perfect for dual-income families with limited time, seniors who struggle with hand washing, and single- or two-person households. It significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes, saving time and energy. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with this product, and it even made me wonder, "Why didn't I just get a dishwasher before?" It offers a low barrier to entry for first-time dishwashers, and I'm completely satisfied with its performance and convenience, making it a highly recommended product.

Comments (English): [ I think I know why people use dishwashers~! ] || ---------------- || I got to use the MyDeer Countertop App-Linked Auto-Open 6-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team, and after using it for a few days, I feel like my quality of life has been upgraded. After the wash is complete, the door opens automatically, releasing hot steam and allowing the interior to dry naturally, eliminating the inconvenience of dripping when removing dishes. Sentence (English): The auto-open door feature is especially convenient.
Comments (English): [ I think I know why people use dishwashers~! ] || ---------------- || I got to use the MyDeer Countertop App-Linked Auto-Open 6-Person Dishwasher through the Coupang Experience Team, and after using it for a few days, I feel like my quality of life has been upgraded. First, let me start with the size and installation. I expected it to be quite large for 6 people, but it actually sits perfectly on the kitchen countertop. Even though my kitchen isn't very spacious, it didn't feel overwhelming, and its simple design blends well with my interior. Installation wasn't difficult either. Simply connect the included hoses and follow the instructions. No complicated construction or special installation was required, so I was able to set it up quickly on my own. Now that I've actually used it, what I'm most pleased with is its cleaning power. Even greasy frying pans, soup-stained rice bowls, and stubbornly stained glass cups sparkled thanks to the high-temperature cleaning. When I wash dishes by hand, no matter how hard I try, water stains or fine grease can still remain. But with the dishwasher, those worries are gone. The auto-open door feature is especially convenient. After the wash is complete, the door opens automatically, releasing hot steam and allowing the interior to dry naturally, eliminating the inconvenience of dripping when removing dishes. This feature alone provided a distinct difference from conventional dishwashers. Another great feature was the app integration. Since I'm usually out and about, I find it inconvenient to wash dishes when I get home, but with the app, I can remotely control the machine and start the wash before I get home. Checking the remaining wash time on the app was also surprisingly convenient. It was quieter than I expected, and it wasn't too noisy, even at night, so I could use it at any time. It also reportedly uses less electricity and water than I expected, which should help reduce my electricity and water bills in the long run. After using it for a few days, I realized this product isn't just a machine that does the dishes for me; it's an appliance that changes my lifestyle. It's especially perfect for dual-income families with limited time, seniors who struggle with hand washing, and single- or two-person households. It significantly reduces the stress of washing dishes, saving time and energy. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with this product, and it even made me wonder, "Why didn't I just get a dishwasher before?" It offers a low barrier to entry for first-time dishwashers, and I'm completely satisfied with its performance and convenience, making it a highly recommended product.

Comments (English): [ Gets the job done! ] || ---------------- || Our Bosch 500 series was easy to install, is mostly easy to use, and has lots of smart features both online and physical. Sentence (English): This model was not in store before I ordered it.
Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY UNLESS YOU ALREADY KNOW HOW TO WORK IT. ] || ---------------- || This model was not in store before I ordered it. Salesperson pressured me to go ahead and pay for the order stating, "We may not have any come in to put on display". That turned out to be a LARGE mistake. The lowest rack of this dishwasher is almost on the floor. I am 5'9" and it is like touching my toes to load the bottom rack. It literally hurts me, and at 72, I don't need to further aggravate my bad back. The much touted top third rack is supposed to hold utensils, but I cannot figure out how this works. I tried to put a spatula in it, and there was only on space that was "tall" enough to fit the spatula's bend. I ran one load this afternoon (ALL afternoon). The loaded dishes were not really dirty. I could have hand washed and dried them in 15 minutes. I just wanted to try new machine. It took over three hours and DID NOT DRY the plastic tops of glass Tupperware containers I use daily. Guess I'll be buying lots more kitchen towels. But the absolute WORST THING about this NOT CHEAP MACHINE is there is NO OPERATION MANUAL. Is that really such a large expense, Whirlpool? They supplied what was called Owner's Manual. Joke. I figured I could get regular manual online, but no such thing exists. This "Manual" contains one page on "Dishwasher Loading Tips". This one page covers three different models, and in no way identifies which one I own. And you guessed it, instructions are different for each "Style". As an example, I quote my "Operation Manual": Your upper RACKS are removable. The manner in which to remove will depend on whether the rack is mounted with Style 1 or Style 2." There are two black and white sketches not even 1 1/2 inches high depicting Style 1 followed by "To remove, pull rack forward about halfway out of tub. On one side press the tab on the track in and pull up the front end of the rack, out of the track. Then repeat this step on the other side to completely remove the front end of the rack. Then remove the rack by pulling the back end out by using a forward and upward motion." I am left totally confused as to how to do this (! ), wondering if this applies to my machine, or if I own Style 2, in which case all these instructions are irrelevant, and I should read on for removal instructions as to Style 2, and further I am left wondering if this allows the removal of the small top rack (which seems useless, and I may like to ditch), or if it only applies to the middle rack. Here's another example of the most unhelpful Manual. "Fold down tines might be in the lower level rack, the second level rack and/or the third level rack, depending on your model. To fold or unfold the tine, hold the tine nearest the clip at at the end of the tine row and gently push it past the stop on the clip and in the direction you want to fold it." That I may be able to figure out, if I can identify where, in any of the three possible locations the tines are! Ridiculously bad directions. Who is the world writes these things? All of this, and I still am ABSOLUTELY UNSURE how to run the next load of dishes. I just need an understandable manual that covers the machine I paid a bunch of money for. What a disaster. I'd almost prefer to hand wash all dishes at this point. If you are super handy, an engineer, or a plumber, maybe this is the machine for you. If you are a single person, who just wants a simple dishwasher that does a good job. DO NOT BUY. Ask about Manuals before you buy. I could not have MORE BUYER'S REMORSE. HUGE MISTAKE TO BUY WHIRPOOL.

Comments (English): [ I'm Frustrated ] || ---------------- || My wife picked out this dishwasher for our new house. We just moved in and have a massive list of things we need to do. The house has sat vacant all summer long. I decided to have Home Depot do the installation $235 seemed like a great deal to save time. Long story short the delivery drivers showed up 45 minutes before my delivery window. The installation tech removed the kicker plate looked underneath the old dishwasher. Then looked at me and said here's the issue. The is mouse crap under here and I'm severely allergic to mouse crap. I won't install your dishwasher today. You can reschedule if you'd like. First, that sounds like a pretty poor excuse to me. If you really are severely allergic to mouse crap, then being a Delivery/Installation Tech is probably the wrong career for you. Second now I got to take time out of my already busy schedule to install my new dishwasher myself because this experience has taught just how reliable Home Depot installation is. To say I'm annoyed would be an understatement.
